We believe there's a massive opportunity to unlock global productivity and sustainability by giving AI the context to understand how every business process really works. Join our mission to make processes work for people, companies, and the planet.</p></div><p><strong>The Team</strong></p> <p>Celonis Services is the delivery engine of our Celonis Customer Organization, responsible for turning the Celonis platform into measurable, business-critical outcomes for our customers. Engineering</li> <li>Review Solution(s) Blueprint to ensure quality, scalability and production readiness of business critical and operational use cases</li> </ul> <p><strong>Domain &amp; Industry Depth</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop and maintain deep expertise in one or more process domains (e.g., Supply Chain, Order to Cash, Procure to Pay, IT Service Management) or industry verticals</li> <li>Translate domain knowledge into scalable solution patterns, reference architectures, and best practices that the broader team can leverage</li> <li>Proactively identify and standardize high-value use cases within your domain in collaboration with the Deployment Engineer, collaborating with Product and Business Apps teams to shape the platform roadmap</li> </ul> <p><strong>Practice Development</strong></p> <ul> <li>Contribute to hiring: define what great looks like for the Deployment job family, conduct interviews, and calibrate candidate assessments</li> <li>Share knowledge across the organization through internal enablement sessions, documentation, and community of practice leadership</li> <li>Ensure the link with Product &amp; Deep understanding of enterprise architecture patterns and trade-offs.</li> <li><strong>AI &amp; agent orchestration: </strong>Demonstrated ability to design AI-augmented delivery workflows leveraging frontier tooling (e.g., Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, etc.). Experience with context engineering, multi-agent system design, or AI validation at scale. Ability to define how AI should be used, not just use it.</li> <li><strong>Domain expertise: </strong>Deep knowledge in at least one major process domain or industry vertical. Ability to translate domain expertise into scalable solution patterns and credible customer advisory.</li> <li><strong>Customer executive presence: </strong>Track record of building trusted advisor relationships with VP and C-level stakeholders. Ability to present transformation strategies, defend architectural decisions, and navigate complex organizational dynamics. Demonstrated experience navigating complex IT landscapes and communicating technical trade-offs to senior leadership.</li> <li><strong>Platform mastery: </strong>Expert-level knowledge of the Celonis platform, including the Process Intelligence Graph, data modeling, advanced PQL, automation and orchestration engine, and AI modules. Experience mentoring technical staff, setting quality standards, and contributing to organizational capability development.</li> <li><strong>Education: </strong>Bachelor’s or Master’s in Computer Science, Engineering, Technology Management, Business Informatics, or a comparable field.</li> <li><strong>Languages: </strong>Fluency in English and German required.&nbsp;</li> </ul><div title: Senior Software Engineer, Proactive Security
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span data-sheets-root="1">About Wolt</span></h2> <p><span data-sheets-root="1">At Wolt, we create technology that brings joy, simplicity and earnings to the neighborhoods of the world. In 2014 we started with delivery of restaurant food. Now we’re building the delivery of (almost) everything and you’ll find us in over 500 cities in 30 countries around the world. In 2022 we joined forces with DoorDash and together we keep on dreaming big and expanding across the globe.<br><br>Working at Wolt isn’t always easy, but it’s definitely exciting. Here you’ll learn more, build more, and ship more than in most other companies. You’ll be challenged a lot, but also have a lot of fun on the way. So, if you’re a self-starter with drive and entrepreneurial spirit, this could be the ride of your life.</span></p></div><p>&nbsp;</p> <p>At Wolt, as a part of Doordash, we’re building the industry’s most scalable and reliable delivery platform to support our three-sided marketplace of consumers, merchants, and courier partners.&nbsp;</p> <p>What makes our team unique:</p> <ul> <li>Our global Security team aspires to be the world’s most admired security team, with members across EU, UK and North America (operating as Wolt, Deliveroo and Doordash).</li> <li>We’re shaping our next generation infrastructure that is hardened from the ground up. This is a rare opportunity - no legacy tech or off-the-shelf product solutions. There is a lot to do around this new development as well as our “classic” platforms of the three companies.</li> <li>The greater team is not just information security - we’re more holistic, and also physical security and safety are a part of our global operations.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>This position is open in our Wolt hubs in <strong>Berlin, Germany</strong>, or <strong>Helsinki, Finland</strong>, and will be a part of the Global Security Engineering team.</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>Day-to-day in this role you’ll:</h2> <p>&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Build and maintain core security products, including but not limited to Remote Access Management, Secrets Management, Tokenization, Encryption and Knowledge Graphs, Access Control at global scale.<br><br></li> <li>Partner cross-functionally with Core Infrastructure, Product Engineering, Legal, Security teams and Vendor Partners to build “paved paths” that provide actionable feedback to embed secure design practices into the product and infrastructure development process.<br><br></li> <li>Lead the technical direction and roadmap for your assigned area of ownership.<br><br></li> <li>Build and maintain high Operational Excellence (OE) to ensure we operate T0 services with excellence, rigor and durable standards to ensure minimal to no downtime.<br><br></li> <li>Participate in on-call rotation and promptly respond to on-call events with urgency and rigor.<br><br></li> <li>Manage the lifecycle of security product feature requests and improvements full life-cycle from triage, validation, design, testing, and implementation.<br><br></li> <li>Influence and drive improvements to engineering standards, leverage advancements and LLMs to improve productivity and velocity.<br><br></li> <li>Mentor and coach earlier career engineers, setting and enforcing high standards for Operational Excellence and Software Engineering.<br><br></li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>Over time, your role can evolve depending on your interests and skills. Our company is&nbsp; a large place and there’s a lot to do!</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>As the Security team sometimes needs to address high-priority security issues as well as ensure the availability of the components we have built, this position includes an on-call duty. Und wenn etwas fehlt, organisierst du blitzschnell Nachlieferungen – du behältst immer den Überblick über doe Logistik in deinem Standort.</li> <li><strong>Prozessmanagement:</strong> Du hältst den Betrieb am Laufen durch einen kontinuierlich den Fokus auf unsere betrieblichen Kennzahlen (KPIs) und garantierst, dass alles sicher und wie am Schnürchen läuft, ganz nach unserem Motto: “Safety First”.</li> <li><strong>Teamwork:</strong> Im engen Austausch mit dem Customer-Success Team, unserem Zentrallager (Fulfillment Center) und anderen Hubs machst du unsere Kunden glücklich.</li> <li><strong>Pünktliche Abfahrten:</strong> Dank dir sind unsere Fahrer immer pünktlich unterwegs zu unseren Kunden, damit wir unser versprochenes Zeitfenster einhalten können.</li> <li><strong>Bringe deine Ideen ein</strong>: Von der Koordination der Reparatur unserer Elektrofahrzeuge über die Gestaltung des Hub Layouts bis hin zur Rekrutierung unserer Runner - deine Ideen tragen dazu bei, dass wir gemeinsam weiter wachsen können&nbsp;und unsere Logistikprozesse auf ein neues Level bringen.</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>Das bringst du mit&nbsp;</h2> <ul> <li>Ein Studium oder abgeschlossene Berufsausbildung in der Logistik, dem Einzelhandel oder in ähnlichen Bereichen.&nbsp;</li> <li>Erste Erfahrungen in der Führung von Teams - entweder im Beruf oder du hast bereits ein anderes Erfolgsteam gecoached.</li> <li>Fließende Deutsch- und basic Englischkenntnisse.</li> <li>Du bist im Besitz eines gültigen Führerscheins der Klasse B.</li> <li>Gute kommunikative Fähigkeiten und ein selbstbewusstes Auftreten.</li> <li>Du magst es, Entscheidungen auf Grundlage von Zahlen und Fakten zu treffen.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>&nbsp;</p> <h2>Darauf kannst du dich freuen</h2> <ul> <li><strong>Starte durch - mit uns: </strong>Werde Teil unseres internationalen Teams in einem Umfeld, das echtes Wachstum und eine „Act like an Owner“-Mentalität fördert. title: Engineering Manager, ChatBots and AI
description: <div class="content-intro"><h2><span style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);"><strong>About Workato</strong></span></h2> <p><span style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);">Workato is the leading Control and Execution Platform for Enterprise AI — the neutral platform enterprises trust to put AI to work across their business. Workato unifies data, applications, and processes into a single platform so AI can reliably orchestrate business processes in production at enterprise scale. Built on more than a decade of running mission-critical processes for over half the Fortune 500 — including Nasdaq, Amazon, Cisco, Vodafone, Atlassian, and Lucid Motors — Workato turns over 14,000 enterprise systems AI needs to act on into one governed execution layer. For more information, visit <span style="color: rgb(0, 212, 216);"><a style="color: rgb(0, 212, 216);" href="https://www.workato.com/" data-tooltip-link-label="undefined">workato.com</a>.</span></span></p> <h2><span style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);"><strong>Why join us?</strong></span></h2> <p><span style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);">Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a <strong>flexible, trust-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles</strong>. We are driven by <strong>innovation </strong>and looking for<strong> team players </strong>who want to actively build our company.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);">But, we also believe in <strong>balancing productivity with self-care</strong>. That’s why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment <span style="color: rgb(0, 212, 216);"><a style="color: rgb(0, 212, 216);" href="http://www.workato.com/careers">along with a multitude of benefits</a></span> they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives.&nbsp;</span></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);">If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you!</span></p> <p><span style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);">Also, feel free to check out why:</span></p> <ul> <li style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);"><span style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);"><span style="color: rgb(0, 212, 216);"><a style="color: rgb(0, 212, 216);" href="https://www.businessinsider.com/47-enterprise-startups-to-bet-your-career-on-in-2020-2019-12">Business Insider</a></span> named us an “enterprise startup to bet your career on”</span></li> <li style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);"><span style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);"><span style="color: rgb(0, 212, 216);"><a style="color: rgb(0, 212, 216);" href="https://www.forbes.com/cloud100/#a57477b5f941">Forbes’ Cloud 100</a></span> recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world</span></li> <li style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);"><span style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);"><a style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);" href="https://www2.deloitte.com/us/en/pages/technology-media-and-telecommunications/articles/fast500-winners.html"><span style="color: rgb(0, 212, 216);">Deloitte Tech Fast 500</span></a> ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America</span></li> <li style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);"><span style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);"><a style="color: rgb(8, 55, 99);" href="https://qz.com/work/2053446/the-best-companies-for-working-from-home/"><span style="color: rgb(0, 212, 216);">Quartz</span></a> ranked us the #1 best company for remote workers</span></li> </ul></div><h3><strong>Workato is looking for an Engineering Manager to lead the ChatBots and AI team within our Platform organization. This is a high-ownership role for someone who thrives in ambiguity: you turn unclear requirements into clear execution plans, make confident decisions with incomplete information, and keep both the team and leadership aligned. The team is fully remote and international - you'll build the processes and culture that make it work at pace.</strong></h3> <h2>About the Team</h2> <p>The ChatBots and AI team's mission is to deliver AI agents to end users. Intégré au sein d’une équipe, tu travailleras principalement sur l'ERP, encore en construction : tu participeras à le concevoir et à l'amener jusqu'à la production. Le produit historique reste en production et l'équipe continue de le faire vivre. Ce que tu vas faire chez nous Build & Run de A à Z : tu conçois et fais évoluer des features end-to-end : design, développement, releases et suivi en production. Hands-on & design : tu codes, refactores et améliores l'existant. Tu participes à l'architecture avec le CTO et poses les bases d'un système capable de scaler. PR review & excellence technique : tu élèves le niveau de l'équipe en challengeant le code, la modélisation, les cas limites et la maintenabilité. Intégrations robustes : tu construis des APIs et des systèmes résilients adaptés à des contraintes métier fortes. Fiabilité & observabilité : tu conçois des systèmes capables de détecter et prévenir les problèmes avant qu'ils n'atteignent les utilisateurs. Leadership technique : tu accompagnes les développeurs de l'équipe, partages tes pratiques et fais grandir les personnes autour de toi. Ce qui t'attend techniquement Stack : TypeScript, Next.js, NestJS, MongoDB, Redis, AWS, monorepo Turborepo Observabilité : Sentry, BetterStack, OpenTelemetry Façon de travailler : Kanban, sans sprint. On livre en petits incréments et on deploy plusieurs fois par jour Profil recherché 6+ ans d'expérience avec une expérience prouvée sur des produits en production utilisés par de vrais utilisateurs. Tu as déjà construit et opéré un backend dans la durée. Tu connais les compromis d'une architecture qui doit tenir dans le temps. Tu es capable de couvrir tout le cycle : compréhension du produit, system design, développement, déploiement et run. Tu as le réflexe des cas limites. Quand on manipule des documents légaux et des données dont nos clients dépendent au quotidien, la question « que se passe-t-il si cet appel échoue au milieu ? » compte plus que la maîtrise d'un framework. Tu sais prendre des décisions avec une information incomplète et les assumer. On cherche quelqu'un qui tranche, pas quelqu'un qui organise une quatrième réunion. Tu sais avancer dans l'imparfait. La dette technique existe, elle est nommée et priorisée : tu préfères faire progresser le produit plutôt que de viser une perfection théorique. Tu utilises l'IA au quotidien et tu veux participer à construire nos pratiques et nos outils, pas seulement coder plus vite. Tu as déjà joué un rôle de Tech Lead : ownership d'un système, décisions d'architecture et accompagnement d'autres développeurs. Processus de recrutement Echange RH Entretien technique avec un développeur de l'équipe Entretien technique (algorithme et design technique) avec le CTO Entretien de fit avec deux des fondateurs Prise de référence et offre Conditions Salaire : 50-65 k€ selon expérience Télétravail : full remote (et des bureaux à Paris si tu en as envie) Find more English Speaking Jobs in Germany on Arbeitnow

description: At remberg, you’ll help to keep the world running. Everything that gets produced relies on a maintenance team behind the scenes that keeps the machines, equipment and infrastructure running. We are helping these teams by simplifying their work with modern, agentic maintenance software. At remberg, we are serving clients like Remondis, Würth, Edeka, Rotkäppchen and 300+ more. Supported by the visionary founders of category-defining businesses such as Celonis, Dash0, UiPath, Personio and Forto, as well as leading investors like Earlybird, Speedinvest, Oxx, Acton, and Fly Ventures, remberg is positioned to be the European category leader for modern, agentic maintenance software. WHAT THE ROLE OFFERS Als Forward Deployed Engineer sorgst du dafür, dass remberg bei unseren Kunden zum Herzstück der Instandhaltung wird. Du arbeitest hands-on zwischen Prospects, Kunden, Product und Engineering. Du verbindest remberg mit SAP und anderen ERP-Systemen, bringst Sensor- und Maschinendaten auf die Plattform und gibst der remberg KI den Kontext, den sie braucht, um in der Industrie echten Mehrwert zu liefern. Du baust, was Kund:innen brauchen, bringst es schnell live und lässt deine Learnings direkt ins Produkt einfließen. Als erster FDE bei remberg gestaltest du die Rolle von Grund auf und baust die ersten Playbooks. Du berichtest direkt an Julian Borg, unseren Co-Founder und CPO, und arbeitest eng mit Kunden, Go-to-Market sowie Product und Engineering zusammen. Du arbeitest hybrid aus unserem Office in München und bist im Schnitt ein paar Tage im Monat bei Kunden vor Ort. THE IMPACT YOU'LL HAVE SAP/ERP-Integration: Du entwickelst Integrationen zwischen remberg und SAP (z. B. SAP PM/MM, S/4HANA, ECC) oder anderen ERP-Systemen. Dabei begleitest du sie vom technischen Scoping über das Data Mapping bis zum stabilen Betrieb nach dem Go-live. Kundenkommunikation: Für Instandhaltung, Operations und IT bist du die technische Ansprechperson, vor Ort und remote. Du übersetzt Business-Anforderungen in technische Lösungen und erklärst sie so, dass alle mitkommen. Bei Kundencalls und Sales Deals in der späten Phase bist du dabei, schätzt Machbarkeit und Aufwand ein und beantwortest IT- und Security-Fragen. Sensor-Integration: Du bindest Maschinen- und Sensordaten (z. B. über IoT-Plattformen, OPC UA, MQTT oder Kunden-APIs) an remberg an und ermöglichst so zustandsbasierte Instandhaltung und automatisch ausgelöste Aufträge. AI Context Engineering: Du bereitest Kundendaten, Dokumente und Instandhaltungswissen so auf, dass die remberg KI präzise und verlässliche Antworten liefert. Gemeinsam mit Kunden prüfst du die Ergebnisse und verbesserst den Kontext Schritt für Schritt. Product-Feedback-Loop: Wenn mehrere Kunden vor derselben Herausforderung stehen, machst du mit Product und Engineering aus der Einzellösung ein Feature für alle. Du baust wiederverwendbare Integrationspakete und schreibst Playbooks, mit denen AEs und CSMs Standardfragen selbst beantworten können. HOW YOU'LL GROW WITH US Erfahrung: 3+ Jahre in Software Engineering, Solutions oder Integration Engineering, technischer Beratung, Product Management oder ähnlichen Rollen, idealerweise im B2B-Software-, Industrie- oder Fertigungsumfeld. Kommunikation: Du kommunizierst sicher mit Stakeholdern vom Shopfloor über die IT bis zum Management, gehst Probleme strukturiert an und willst Dinge shippen. Integrations-Know-how: Hands-on-Erfahrung mit APIs (REST, OData), Data Mapping und Enterprise-Systemen. Erfahrung mit SAP oder anderen ERP-Systemen ist ein großes Plus. Industriedaten & IoT: Du kennst dich mit Sensordaten, IoT-Plattformen oder Industrieprotokollen (z. B. OPC UA, MQTT) aus oder hast richtig Lust, dich einzuarbeiten. Engineering Skills: Solide Programmierkenntnisse (z. B. Python oder TypeScript) und SQL sowie praktische Erfahrung mit LLMs. Mobilität: Du bist bereit, im Schnitt ein paar Tage pro Monat zu Kunden zu reisen. Zudem hast du einen Führerschein, damit du dabei flexibel bist. Sprachen: Fließendes Deutsch (C2) und Englisch (C1) in Wort und Schrift. EVERYTHING YOU NEED TO THRIVE 💰 Competitive compensation package : Enjoy a salary, benefits, and equity*, with annual reviews. 💻 State-of-the-art tools and equipment for a modern and efficient setup. 🍏 Health and wellness benefits : Access to Nilo Health, JobRad*, and your choice between a GUUD card or Wellpass / Urban Sports Club for sports and fitness. 🥨 Prime office location & culture : Our office is in the heart of Munich, near the main train station, making it easily accessible for commuters and travelers. Our office is always lively, with 3 days/week in the office. 🌞 Work-from-anywhere flexibility : You can work remotely for up to 3 months per year. 🌴 Attractive Compensation & Benefits : In addition to a competitive salary, you'll enjoy different company benefits and 30 vacation days*. 📚 Continuous learning : Get a €1,500 development budget plus 1 day of educational leave per year.* 🤝 Volunteering day : 1 paid day per year to give back to a cause you care about. *Some perks apply to permanent full-time employees only. Today, we are serving clients like Remondis, Würth, Edeka, Rotkäppchen and 300+ more. Überblick Wir suchen einen erfahrenen Electroniker, der die elektrische Verkabelung und Steuerungssysteme unserer autonomen Robotersysteme installiert, verkabelt und in Stand hält. In dieser Rolle arbeitest du eng mit unserem Mechanical- und Hardware-Team zusammen, um sicherzustellen, dass alle elektrischen Komponenten zuverlässig funktionieren und nahtlos in die Gesamtsysteme integriert sind. Deine Aufgaben Elektrokonstruktion und Planung: Elektrokonstruktion gemäß geltenden Richtlinien und Normen. Erstellung von Schaltplänen für unsere Robotersysteme. Installation und Verkabelung: Verkabelung und Installation elektrischer Komponenten und Steuerungssysteme in unseren Robotersystemen. Montage von Schaltschränken, Steckverbindern und Sensorik nach technischen Zeichnungen und Schaltplänen. Verlegung und Anschluss von Kabeln unter Einhaltung geltender Sicherheits- und Qualitätsstandards. Test, Wartung und Fehlerbehebung: Prüfung und Inbetriebnahme elektrischer Systeme vor Auslieferung und Installation beim Kunden. Diagnose und Behebung elektrischer Störungen während der Entwicklung, der Fertigung und im laufenden Betrieb. Durchführung regelmäßiger Wartungs- und Sicherheitsprüfungen an bestehenden Systemen. Sicherer Umgang mit Schaltplänen sowie Kenntnisse in Verkabelung, Verdrahtung und Anschlusstechnik. Erfahrung im Umgang mit Mess- und Prüfgeräten (z. B. Multimeter, Oszilloskop). Kenntnisse relevanter elektrischer Sicherheitsnormen und -vorschriften. Erfahrung in der Robotik, Automatisierungstechnik oder im Maschinenbau von Vorteil. Hier bei CloudFactory haben wir eine klare Mission. Wir wollen das Potenzial der künstlichen Intelligenz erschließen, um weltweit positive Veränderungen zu bewirken. Durch die Kombination aus fortschrittlicher Technologie und einem globalen Netzwerk talentierter Menschen machen wir ungenutzte Daten nutzbar und schaffen so weltweit echten Mehrwert im großen Maßstab.

Wir sind mehr als nur ein Arbeitsplatz: Wir sind eine globale Gemeinschaft, die auf starken Beziehungen und der Überzeugung basiert, dass sinnvolle Arbeit Leben verändert. Unser Leitprinzip „Earning, Learning, and Serving“ (Verdienen, Lernen und Dienen) prägt unser tägliches Handeln. Außerdem verfolgen wir das Ziel, eine Million Menschen mit zukunftsfähiger Arbeit zu verbinden und Führungspersönlichkeiten zu entwickeln, die andere inspirieren.

Unsere Kultur

Bei CloudFactory glauben wir daran, ein Arbeitsumfeld zu schaffen, in dem sich alle bestärkt, wertgeschätzt und inspiriert fühlen. Jeder soll seine eigene Persönlichkeit und individuellen Stärken bei der Arbeit voll entfalten können.

Wir sind:

  • Missionsorientiert: Wir konzentrieren uns darauf, wirtschaftliche und gesellschaftliche Wirkung zu erzielen.
  • Menschenzentriert: Die persönliche Weiterentwicklung, das Wohlbefinden und das Zugehörigkeitsgefühl unseres Teams liegen uns sehr am Herzen.
  • Innovativ: Wir begrüßen Veränderungen und finden gemeinsam bessere Wege, Dinge anzugehen.
  • Global vernetzt: Wir fördern die Zusammenarbeit zwischen verschiedenen Kulturen und Perspektiven.

Wenn Sie sich für Innovation und Zusammenarbeit begeistern und in einem internationalen Umfeld wirklich etwas bewegen möchten, dann freuen wir uns darauf, Sie in unserem Team willkommen zu heißen!

Ihre Position im Team
Als unser Senior Accountant - Finance & Payroll (m/w/d) verantworten Sie die Finanzbuchhaltung, die Lohnabrechnung sowie die Einhaltung aller gesetzlichen Vorgaben für die deutsche Tochtergesellschaft von CloudFactory, die Hasty GmbH mit Sitz in Berlin. Sie arbeiten eng mit dem globalen Group Finance Team sowie den lokalen Fachabteilungen zusammen. Die Rolle bietet Ihnen ideale Voraussetzungen, sich fachlich wie persönlich weiterzuentwickeln und gleichzeitig Teil eines sinnstiftenden Unternehmens zu sein.

Arbeitsmodell
Hybrid / Remote-first - weitgehend mobiles Arbeiten, kombiniert mit regelmäßiger Präsenz in unserem Büro in Berlin (mindestens ein Tag alle zwei Wochen) für den persönlichen Austausch und lokale Aufgaben.

VergütungDiese Position ist sowohl in Vollzeit als auch in Teilzeit zu besetzen. Das Einstiegsgehalt beträgt auf Vollzeitbasis (FTE) 4.311 EUR brutto pro Monat. Die Auszahlung erfolgt monatlich für Vollzeitbeschäftigte. Bei Teilzeitbeschäftigten wird die Vergütung anteilig auf Grundlage der tatsächlich geleisteten Arbeitsstunden berechnet.

Aufgaben und Verantwortlichkeiten

  • Laufende Finanzbuchhaltung: Eigenverantwortliche Steuerung des Tagesgeschäfts (Kontierung sowie Debitoren-, Kreditoren- und Anlagenbuchhaltung) und Sicherstellung einer aktuellen, ordnungsgemäßen Buchführung.
  • Organisation der Entgeltabrechnung: Verantwortung für die monatliche Entgeltabrechnung in Deutschland, einschließlich Gehaltsanpassungen, Personalveränderungen, lohnsteuer- und sozialversicherungsrechtlicher Meldungen sowie enger Abstimmung mit dem lokalen HR-Team.
  • Steuerliche Themen & Compliance: Vorbereitung, Koordination und fristgerechte Abgabe aller erforderlichen Steuererklärungen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit unserem Steuerberater.
  • Schnittstelle für Prüfer und Behörden: Hauptansprechperson für externe Wirtschaftsprüfer, Steuerberater und deutsche Finanzbehörden, einschließlich der Unterstützung bei gesetzlichen Jahresabschlussprüfungen und der Beantwortung von fachlichen Rückfragen.
  • Monats- und Jahresabschlüsse: Unterstützung bei der Erstellung von Monats- und Jahresabschlüssen in enger Zusammenarbeit mit dem Group Finance Team zur Sicherstellung einer präzisen Finanzberichterstattung.
  • Corporate Governance & Verwaltung: Koordination gesellschaftsrechtlicher und administrativer Prozesse der deutschen Niederlassung in Zusammenarbeit mit der lokalen Geschäftsführung und internen Stakeholdern.
  • Büro Management & Onboarding: Unterstützung bei der Verwaltung des Berliner Büros, einschließlich der Koordination von On- und Offboarding-Prozessen für Mitarbeitende und externe Dienstleister (Contractors).
  • Teamübergreifende Zusammenarbeit: Enge Abstimmung mit lokalen und globalen Teams, um reibungslose Finanzprozesse und eine schnelle Klärung operativer Fragestellungen sicherzustellen.
  • Kultur & Miteinander: Aktive Mitgestaltung einer positiven Arbeitsatmosphäre am Standort Berlin, beispielsweise durch die Unterstützung lokaler Gemeinschaftsprojekte und Mitarbeiteraktivitäten.

Requirements

  • Sprachkenntnisse: Verhandlungssichere Deutsch- und fließende Englischkenntnisse in Wort und Schrift für die tägliche Kommunikation mit deutschen Behörden, externen Beratern und dem internationalen Team.
  • Qualifikation: Abgeschlossene kaufmännische Ausbildung im Bereich Buchhaltung/Finanzen (z. B. als Steuerfachangestellte/r), idealerweise ergänzt durch eine Weiterbildung zum/zur Bilanzbuchhalter/-in (IHK) oder eine vergleichbare Qualifikation.
  • Berufserfahrung: Mehrjährige relevante Berufserfahrung (idealerweise 5+ Jahre) im Finanz- und Rechnungswesen mit nachweislicher Verantwortung für die laufende Buchhaltung.
  • HGB- & Steuerkenntnisse: Fundierte praktische Erfahrung mit deutschen Rechnungslegungs- und Steuervorschriften (HGB), idealerweise im Umfeld einer GmbH oder einer vergleichbaren deutschen Kapitalgesellschaft.
  • Entgeltabrechnung: Praktische Erfahrung in der deutschen Entgeltabrechnung, einschließlich des dazugehörigen Meldewesens.
  • Abschluss- und Prüfungserfahrung: Erfahrung in der Vorbereitung oder Koordination von Jahresabschlüssen und Steuererklärungen nach deutschem Recht sowie effektive und professionelle Zusammenarbeit mit Steuerberatern, Wirtschaftsprüfern und deutschen Finanzbehörden.
  • Arbeitsweise & Persönlichkeit: Selbstständige, strukturierte und äußerst sorgfältige Arbeitsweise sowie eine klare und souveräne Kommunikation gegenüber externen und internen Ansprechpartnern.

At Flix, we offer a dynamic work environment with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a tech-driven approach to making travel more accessible, sustainable, and affordable.  

We're looking for a motivated and driven Working Student - Network Planning (m/f/d) who will help us shape our team, drive the company to the next level, and have the most direct influence on our success. You will join our international Team Network Planning - Europe East.

This position is part-time (20 hours per week), based in our Berlin office (hybrid model).

About the Role

  • Perform data entry, tracking, and validation across tools (Excel, Planr, Salesforce, backend systems, etc.), including regular data updates and quality checks
  • Support preparation of presentations, reports, analyses, and maps
  • Support the team in network planning activities in order to open sales and adapt our offer to transportation demand
  • Take meeting notes, clean up content, and provide concise summaries
  • Support the analysis of our network with various datasets and reports in order to continuously improve our service
  • Prepare important documentation for the authorization of new bus lines
  • Provide operational support throughout the annual timeline

About You

  • Enrolled student or graduate in Transportation Planning, Engineering, Economics, Mathematics, Urban Planning, Geography, Tourism or similar
  • You're passionate about the transportation sector and show a keen interest in schedule and network planning
  • Strong analytical skills, readiness of mind and a goal-driven personality
  • Fluent in English, all other European languages are considered as a plus
  • Accurate work style as well as strong communication skills
  • Skilled user of the MS Office programs, especially Word and Excel

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

At Flix, you'll find teams that rally together to overcome challenges and spark creativity. We believe in ownership culture - giving you the freedom to take initiative, make an impact, and shape your own career path.
As we continue to expand across the globe, you can make a real difference in how we work.

If you're ready to grow and lead your journey, Flix is the place for you!

raw.title: Senior Java Engineer (m/f/d) - Flix Train
raw.description:
At Flix, we offer a tech-driven environment where innovation meets real-world impact, with competitive pay, strong growth opportunities, and a culture of collaboration and ownership.  

As a Senior Java Engineer (m/f/d) in the Supply Division, you can make an impact by automating and streamlining FlixTrain's operational processes, creating internal tools that help teams manage a growing and increasingly modern fleet. You'll join a small, collaborative team (6 people) with a strong sense of ownership and a pragmatic, low-bureaucracy way of working.

This role sits in a greenfield environment, where many systems are designed and built from scratch. Engineers are actively involved throughout the entire lifecycle: understanding operational challenges, contributing to architectural decisions, and ensuring high quality through solid testing practices. We value engineers who are curious about the business, eager to participate in discovery and problem framing, and comfortable navigating ambiguity.

Our Tech Stack: Java, Spring/Spring Boot, Kafka, MySQL (RDS), MongoDB (DocumentDB), AWS, Docker, Gitlab CI, Kubernetes, Terraform, Datadog

About the Role

  • You will be part of a self-organized, cross-functional distributed team owning set of products and will hence directly contribute to the success of the business
  • You and your team will place our users at the center when developing solutions together
  • You drive the development process using an Agile environment
  • You will be able to design new products from scratch and frequently deliver new versions of existing products, using continuous integration and automation
  • You will work with and learn how to use cutting-edge technologies and tools
  • Lead technical decisions inside and across teams to improve technical excellence through lateral leadership
  • Be a mentor and coach for your colleagues

About You

  • 7+ years of professional experience with Java 
  • Strong experience developing distributed systems using Spring Boot 
  • Experience with relational (MySQL, PostgreSQL, RDS) and no-SQL databases (MongoDB, DocumentDB) 
  • Experience with caching solutions such us Redis, ElastiCache 
  • Experience with event-driven architectures and messaging services like Kafka/SQS/SNS/RabbitMQ 
  • Hands-on experience with AWS services (e.g. RDS, S3, EC2) 
  • Experience with DevOps and infrastructure technologies, including Docker, k8s, GitLab CI, Terraform, and Datadog 
  • Upper-intermediate level of English or higher  
  • Experience working within an Agile setup 

Nice to have: 

  • Data Engineering skills: ETL, Snowflake, etc.
  • You've worked with distributed teams before
  • Upper-intermediate level of German or higher 

We recognize that everyone carries a unique set of valuable skills and experiences. If you think you could have an impact even though you don't meet 100% of the requirements, we still encourage you to apply. We want to hear from you!  

What We Offer

  • Travel perks: 12 free Flix vouchers + 12 discount vouchers for friends & family. 
  • Work from (M)Anywhere: Depending on your role, work from another location for up to 60 days per year. 
  • Hybrid work model: We are an office-first company, but we offer flexibility to balance work and life. 
  • Wellbeing support: Access confidential 1:1 counselling, courses, and stress management for yourself and up to four family members. 
  • Learning & Development: Take advantage of language classes, training courses, and expert-led sessions to grow your skills. 
  • Mentoring Program: Connect with experienced colleagues to gain insights and accelerate your career. 

To view more local benefits specific to each office location, please check out this link: Locations - Flix Career

raw.title: Data analyst - AML
raw.description:
About the team:

At SumUp, keeping our platform safe and compliant is critical to the trust of the millions of small businesses we serve around the world.

You'll join our Global AML team at an exciting point in its growth. We're expanding into new markets, evolving our AML capabilities, introducing AI-enabled controls, and navigating increasingly complex regulatory expectations.

As an AML Data Analyst, you'll play a key role in turning AML data into actionable insights. Working closely with our global AML Operations and AML Governance teams, as well as colleagues across Engineering and Data, you'll help us understand how our controls are performing, identify risks and gaps early, and make better decisions as our business scales.

This is a role where your analysis will go beyond reporting. The insights you generate will directly support how we monitor, improve, and strengthen our global AML framework.

 

What you'll do:

  • Build and maintain AML dashboards, operational reports, and data packs used by AML Operations, AML Governance, and senior leadership
  • Design measurement frameworks that track AML operational KPIs, including case volumes, productivity, SLA adherence, and screening hit rates
  • Support AML teams by providing data extracts, analysis, trend identification, and root-cause analysis on AML control outputs and data quality issues
  • Run data validation and quality checks to keep AML data accurate and consistent across systems and regions
  • Support Transaction Monitoring and Sanctions/PEP screening through data analysis, requirements definition, and testing
  • Partner with Engineering and AML Operations to define data requirements and support automation projects
  • Build self-service analytics resources so AML Operations teams can explore data and find insights independently

 

You'll be great for this role if you have:

  • Experience in data analytics, business intelligence, or a similar role within financial services, fintech, compliance, AML, or another regulated environment.
  • Strong SQL skills, including writing complex queries and building reliable datasets for reporting and analysis.
  • Practical experience with Python for data analysis and automation.
  • Experience working with a cloud data warehouse such as Snowflake.
  • Strong analytical skills, with the ability to identify patterns, trends, root causes, and actionable insights from complex data.
  • The ability to translate technical analysis into clear recommendations and stories for non-technical stakeholders and senior leaders.
  • Experience working with data quality, validation, multiple data sources, and competing stakeholder priorities.
  • A proactive, curious mindset and interest in AML, financial crime, fintech, and emerging technologies such as AI, with the ability to take ownership in a fast-changing environment.

title: Prevention Analyst - Pentesting
description: Prevention Analyst - Pentesting About this role We are looking for a Prevention Analyst - Pentester, to join our Prevention track. An attacker does not look at one server in isolation. They look at everything a company exposes to the internet and work out where to start. You will do the same for our clients, taking the attacker’s view of their external attack surface, seeing what an attacker sees, and doing what an attacker would do next. That means reading the story behind an attack surface. A forgotten subdomain, an old login portal, and a misconfigured mail server may each look minor on their own. Together they can show how an organisation has grown, where its blind spots are, and where someone could get in. When you find a potential weak point, you dig into it technically to find out how far an attacker could actually go. This is not a classic penetration testing role. The deep dive draws on pentest methodology and expertise, but it is not a full pentest, and you will not spend your weeks writing long reports. We focus on finding the high impact vulnerabilities that need attention now and getting them to the client in a form they can act on. This is for someone with hands on pentesting experience who wants to work across many customer environments, sharpen their attacker mindset, and grow into owning complex prevention engagements end to end. What you will do Assess clients’ external attack surface as a whole, from the attacker’s perspective. Identify gaps and weaknesses across the surface, not just within a single asset, and work out how they connect. Run technical deep dives into potential weak points to establish how far an attacker could get in practice. Separate what needs fixing now from what does not, and focus on high and critical findings with immediate impact. Turn technical findings into short, clear advice that clients can understand and act on. Share what you learn with the team and actively pick up what others know. We work on problems together. Contribute to improving our approach, sharing ideas that make assessments faster, clearer, and more useful for clients. What you will need Hands on penetration testing experience and a solid grasp of pentest methodology, particularly for external infrastructure and web applications. The ability to think like an attacker, to look at a set of exposed assets and see where you would start and why. Good judgement about real world impact, so you can tell an interesting finding from an urgent one. The ability to explain technical findings to non technical readers, briefly and without losing accuracy. A collaborative way of working and a genuine interest in learning and growing with colleagues, not working as a solo player. Comfortable working across multiple client environments in parallel. raw.title: Solution Consulting Manager
raw.description:
What We Do

Rillet serves accounting and finance teams, the financial brains of their companies. Our job is to help them run the numbers with impossible speed, accuracy, and insight.

Rillet is the Agentic ERP built for modern finance teams. We help companies automate the most critical parts of finance, from closing the books and recognizing revenue to consolidating entities and reporting to investors. More than 600 companies run on Rillet, including Mercor, Scribe, and Function Health, and we partner with leading accounting firms including EY and KPMG.

We’re building in one of the largest software markets in the world, with the momentum to match. Rillet has raised more than $200M, is valued at $1B, and is backed by Sequoia, a16z, ICONIQ, Bain Capital Ventures, Oak HC/FT, and other leading investors. We’re using that backing to build the financial infrastructure for the next generation of companies and help every business run its numbers at the speed of AI.

Who We Are

Rillet’s pace is not for everyone. Intelligence is table stakes. To succeed here, you need extreme speed, agency, and flexibility.

The people who thrive at Rillet do not wait for assignments. They internalize the mission, design a strategy, and bring back results that are better, faster, and more creative than a manager could have asked for.

Our work revolves around our customers. The people who succeed here are energized by delivering what matters most, even when it was not part of the original plan.

Rillet is built on deep accounting expertise, and it takes people from many disciplines to build a category-defining company. You do not need to be an accountant to thrive here. You do need to care deeply about the problems we solve and the impact our customers can create. Together, we combine the precision of accounting with the speed, creativity, and ambition of AI-native software to power the financial core of the world’s fastest-growing companies while redefining what finance teams should expect from their software.

The Role

We have grown quickly, and our Solution Consulting team is at the center of how prospects evaluate Rillet as their next ERP. We are looking for a Solution Consulting Manager to lead and scale that team.

This is a player-coach role weighted heavily toward coaching. You will spend roughly 25% of your time running your own sales cycles (staying sharp, credible and close to the customer and product) and roughly 75% of your time coaching, mentoring and developing your team, primarily by riding shotgun on live deals and giving real-time feedback. You will also be a key voice in shaping the product and building the Solution Consulting infrastructure that lets the organization scale.

You will work directly with the CEO, GTM leadership and the Product team.

Responsibilities

Coach, mentor and develop the team (~75%)

  • Ride shotgun on deals. Join discovery calls, demos, technical validations and POCs to observe, step in when needed, and give specific, real-time feedback. Run tight pre-call prep and post-call debriefs so every deal is a learning opportunity.

  • Raise the bar on craft. Coach Solution Consultants on discovery, value selling, storytelling, demo design, handling technical objections, and tailoring sandbox environments to each customer's use cases.

  • Grow each person individually. Set clear expectations and development plans, give regular honest feedback, and help each Solution Consultant build deep product and accounting domain expertise and advance in their career.

  • Hire and onboard. Recruit, interview and ramp new Solution Consultants, and build an onboarding program that gets them deal-ready quickly.

  • Partner on deal strategy. Work with Account Executives and sales leadership to staff deals, pressure-test strategy on complex ERP evaluations, and keep technical wins on track.

Run your own sales cycles (~25%)

  • Remove technical objections. Take on strategic and complex opportunities, understanding the prospect's business requirements and existing technology stack, and clearly articulating how Rillet integrates and improves their processes.

  • Deliver high-impact demos. Set up and tailor the sandbox environment, answer questions in real time, and act as the prospect's trusted consultant throughout the purchase process.

  • Represent Rillet. Be the face of the company, applying high customer empathy and structured problem-solving to ensure every prospect interaction is excellent, including with finance and accounting leaders.

Inform product and build for scale

  • Be the voice of the prospect. Synthesize front-line feedback, objections, competitive intel and feature gaps from across the team, and bring it to founders and Product in close to real time, with clear patterns and prioritization.

  • Influence the roadmap. Partner with Product on discovery, early feedback on new features, and how capabilities are positioned and demoed.

  • Build Solution Consulting infrastructure. Create the systems, playbooks and tools that help the team scale, such as discovery frameworks, demo standards and reusable assets, sandbox and demo-data templates, technical FAQs and objection libraries, POC and technical-validation processes, a deal-review cadence, and enablement and certification paths.

  • Measure what matters. Define and track team metrics (technical win rate, ramp time, deal coverage, cycle time) and use them to improve how the team operates.

Qualifications

  • 2+ years managing or formally mentoring pre-sales, solutions consulting or sales engineering teams, with a track record of developing people.

  • 3+ years of industry accounting experience across areas such as revenue recognition, month-end close and multi-entity consolidation.

  • 3+ years supporting complex ERP sales cycles with implementation and/or customer support for accounting or financial solutions.

  • Deep knowledge of the ecosystem of tools in the office of the CFO.

  • Excellent communicator who makes complex concepts easy to understand, and who can give direct, constructive feedback in the moment.

  • Experience building processes, enablement or tooling for a growing team, ideally in an early-stage, fast-moving environment.

  • Thrives in a dynamic environment while keeping high attention to detail.

  • CPA certification or having started your career in audit is a plus.

Note: All official Rillet recruiting communications will come from an @rillet.com email address. If you’re contacted from another domain, please disregard the message and report it as spam.

Life at Rillet

  • Competitive pay and meaningful equity. Be rewarded for the value you help create.

  • Benefits that support you. We offer competitive benefits designed to support your health, wellbeing, time away from work, family, and long-term financial goals.

  • Better together. We value collaboration, connection, and spending meaningful time together as a team. We regularly create opportunities to connect through team meals, events, and company gatherings.

title: Software Development Engineer in Test II, NavNative
description: Mapbox is the leading real-time location platform for a new generation of location-aware businesses. Mapbox is the only platform that equips organizations with the full set of tools to power the navigation of people, packages, and vehicles everywhere. More than 4 million registered developers have chosen Mapbox because of the platform’s flexibility, security and privacy compliance. Organizations use Mapbox applications, data, SDKs and APIs to create customized and immersive experiences that delight their customers. What We Do The Navigation Native team builds the high-performance C++ engine that serves as the "brain" of our Navigation SDKs. This library runs directly on end-user systems (on-board), powering everything from mobile apps to in-vehicle infotainment systems for partners like BMW, Porsche, and Zeekr. We solve the fundamental challenges of movement: transforming noisy GPS/IMU data into precise map-matching, managing complex road-network graphs, supporting routes and alternatives, tracking progress along a route, and providing "Electronic Horizon" capabilities for ADAS. Our work happens at the edge, supporting location frequencies up to 10Hz and ensuring a seamless experience even in tunnels or dense urban canyons. As AI becomes embedded in modern engineering workflows, we value engineers who can thoughtfully integrate AI into design, development, and decision-making. Our interview process will include discussion of how you use AI in your engineering workflow. What You'll Do We are looking for smart, fast-learning engineers who care as much about proving that navigation works as about making it work. As an SDE(T), you will: Build and maintain the unit, integration, and functional test architecture for a C++17 library, and the CMake and CI pipelines that run it. Turn real-world location recordings into regression tests, and define the quality metrics for map-matching, routing, and route-following. Keep the quality signal fast and trustworthy: eliminate flaky tests, run sanitizer and performance builds, and track coverage. Build AI-driven test tooling: agent-based test generation, automated dogfooding and triage, and AI-assisted PR review. Partner with feature engineers on testability and review designs for how they will be verified. Thoughtfully leverage AI tools in your workflow and set the standard for how the team uses them. What We Believe Are Important Traits for This Role 5+ years of experience in C++17: comfortable writing test code and tooling, reading production code, and debugging with sanitizers and profilers. Python or similar for harnesses and analysis. Proven experience building test infrastructure for a large native codebase: test frameworks, CMake, and CI systems. A data-driven mindset: you define metrics, build the tooling to measure them, and use them to argue for or against a change. Experience diagnosing hard-to-reproduce failures: flakiness, platform-specific behavior, memory and threading bugs. Strong English skills, with the ability to explain test results, risk, and trade-offs to peers and stakeholders. Would be a Plus Familiarity with navigation concepts (map matching, dead reckoning, route progress, or Electronic Horizon). Experience with replay- or simulation-based testing using real sensor and GPS data. Hands-on experience building AI- or agent-based developer tooling for testing, code review, or triage. Experience with coverage tooling, performance benchmarking, or testing SDKs through generated bindings. Employment Requirements Employment Type: Full-time Weekly Hours: 40 h per week Location/Hybrid Policy: Remote (from any city in Germany) What We Value In addition to our core values , which are not unique to this position and are necessary for Mapbox leaders: We value high-performing creative individuals who dig into problems and opportunities. We believe in individuals being their whole selves at work. We commit to this through supportive health care, parental leave, flexibility for the things that come up in life, and innovating on how we think about supporting our people. We emphasize an environment of teaching and learning to equip employees with the tools needed to be successful in their function and the company. We strongly believe in the value of growing a diverse team and encourage people of all backgrounds, genders, ethnicities, abilities, and sexual orientations to apply. How We Support You Hybrid/Remote Options: Enjoy flexibility to work comfortably from home or periodically from an office where applicable. Country-Specific Care & Coverage: Private health, dental, and income protection plans tailored to elevate your regional statutory benefits. Family-First Support: Family care, maternity and paternity leave policies to support your growing family. Lifestyle Spending Account: Contributions to support your health, wellness, and personal growth. Balance & Brainpower: Mental health support for you and your dependents. Today, that time is lost to busywork and complex systems that pull them away from what matters most: people . Our mission is backed with a $50M Series A funding led by Balderton Capital, with support from HV Capital, Y Combinator and other leading VCs. What makes this role unique is the level of ownership and impact. You’ll work in small, highly collaborative product teams where design decisions meaningfully shape product direction. From discovery through rollout, you’ll stay hands-on through implementation and iteration, shipping work that is not just thoughtful, but truly impactful! 🚀 Your Daily Business You’ll work close to the realities of frontline care . Map end-to-end journeys, prototype interactions, and craft production-ready UI that holds up in high-pressure environments. Go where the work happens. Join on-site visits and user sessions, watch real workflows, and capture the constraints that never show up in specs. Obsess over users, drive adoption. Design for diverse user groups with varying levels of tech comfort, and understand how your work drives adoption. Turn insight into direction. Synthesize research into clear problem statements, hypotheses, and UX principles the team can rally around. Balance speed and quality. Use AI-assisted workflows and tools to accelerate exploration and prototyping without compromising craft or usability. Be a partner to Product and Engineering. Make trade-offs explicit, unblock decisions, and stay close through implementation so what ships matches what was intended. Drive consistency through shared solutions. You have contributed to a large design initiative (e.g. a product redesign) and helped drive it toward measurable success. You are strong in interaction design and visual craft and sweat the details. You are fluent in Figma and comfortable using modern AI tools to accelerate research, ideation, and prototyping You communicate design intent in a way engineers & product managers can implement without guesswork. You understand mobile design patterns (Android + iOS) and can simplify complex, real-world workflows for users who are not tech-native. You operate well in ambiguity: you ask the right questions, make pragmatic trade-offs, and keep quality high. You bring the human side: empathy, direct communication, and high accountability . You are fluent in English 🌱 Growing together - what you can expect at voize We are a fast-growing startup, that means you will tackle challenges, grow quickly, and make a real impact, giving frontline workers more time for people. We foster an open, collaborative culture with regular team events, whether you work from our Berlin office or remotely across Germany. You become a co-creator of our success with stock options. title: Senior CRM & Lifecycle Analyst (B2C) – Marketing Automation (all genders)
description: Analytics first: Du baust CRM und Lifecycle Marketing bei Foodji komplett neu auf, vom analytischen Fundament bis zur Integration der Systeme – datengetrieben, KI-enabled und mit hohem Iterationstempo. In dieser neu geschaffenen Rolle verantwortest du die Segmentierungs- und Journey-Logik unserer B2C-Kommunikation. Dein Werkzeug sind Daten, nicht Pixel: Du entwickelst Hypothesen, übersetzt sie in Events, Segmente und Journey-Konzepte, wertest Tests aus und iterierst schnell auf Basis der Ergebnisse. Kampagnen und Content kommen aus dem Marketing- und UI/UX-Team, du lieferst das Wer, Wann und Warum. Rund 60 bis 70 Prozent deiner Arbeit sind Analytics, und KI-Tools wie Claude nutzt du dabei ganz selbstverständlich. Foodji ist dabei kein klassischer Onlineshop: Jeder Foodji hat individuelle Stocklevels und Produktkombinationen. Genau das macht CRM bei uns besonders spannend. Dazu kommt eine riesige Datenbasis: Fast alle Kund:innen sind registriert und haben ein eigenes Profil. Du entwickelst die Logik für dynamische, hochgradig segmentierte Kommunikation über alle Kanäle – von der Foodji App über In-App-Messages, Push und Mail bis zum Foodji Screen direkt am Gerät – und nutzt Daten, um sie kontinuierlich weiterzuentwickeln. Deine Mission bei Foodji Du legst das analytische und konzeptionelle Fundament für eine skalierbare CRM- und Lifecycle-Funktion für unsere B2C-Kund:innen. Von der Hypothese über Segmentierung und Testdesign bis zur Auswertung von A/B-Tests und Kohorten: Du definierst, was wir ausprobieren, misst, was wirkt, und iterierst schnell auf Basis der Ergebnisse. Welche Events lösen welche Kommunikation aus? Du definierst sie auf Basis unserer Daten, konzipierst dynamische Segmente und Journeys, die Stocklevels, Produktkombinationen und Nutzerbedürfnisse berücksichtigen, und entscheidest datenbasiert, ob App, In-App, Push, Mail oder Foodji Screen der richtige Kanal ist. In Snowflake und mit KI-Tools wie Claude analysierst du Daten eigenständig, findest die relevanten Hebel und priorisierst Maßnahmen nach ihrem erwarteten Impact. Mit Marketing, Product, Revenue Management und BI arbeitest du eng zusammen und machst Daten und technische Möglichkeiten für CRM nutzbar. Dem Team, das Kampagnen und Content umsetzt, lieferst du Segmente, Journey-Konzepte und klare Briefings. Du verantwortest Datenqualität und Governance deiner Segmente, Events und Systeme und stellst sicher, dass alles performant, sicher und datenschutzkonform läuft. Du baust unser CRM komplett neu auf und übernimmst die Projektverantwortung für die Integration in unsere System- und Datenlandschaft, von der Anforderungsdefinition bis zum Go-live. Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder vergleichbare Plattformen kennst du so gut, dass deine Konzepte direkt umsetzbar sind. DAS BRINGST DU MIT Mindestens 3 Jahre Erfahrung in CRM Analytics, Data Analytics, Lifecycle Marketing oder einem vergleichbaren Bereich. Ausgeprägter Datenblick: Du arbeitest sicher mit Daten in Snowflake oder vergleichbaren Data Warehouses, baust komplexe Segmente und Kohorten und leitest daraus klare Maßnahmen ab. Analytics first: Rund 60 bis 70 Prozent deiner Arbeit sind für dich Analytics. Du iterierst schnell über Hypothesen, A/B-Tests und Kohortenanalysen, statt lange an der perfekten Gestaltung zu feilen. Du bist komplett KI-enabled: Tools wie Claude oder MCP nutzt du ganz selbstverständlich in deinem Arbeitsalltag. Gute Kenntnisse in Salesforce Marketing Cloud, Braze oder einer vergleichbaren CRM-Plattform: Du weißt, was technisch möglich ist, und konzipierst Segmente und Journeys entsprechend. Ein Plus ist Erfahrung mit Omnichannel-Journeys über App, Push, In-App und Mail. Technisches Verständnis und Lust auf enge Zusammenarbeit mit Product: Du kennst die Abläufe zwischen CRM-Systemen, Plattformen und Datenquellen und achtest auf Performance, Sicherheit und Datenschutz. Erfahrung im Aufbau oder in der Einführung eines CRM-Systems: Du übernimmst Ownership, treibst die Integration als Projekt eigenverantwortlich voran und koordinierst die beteiligten Teams und Dienstleister. Sichere Kommunikation auf Deutsch oder Englisch in Wort und Schrift. Noch Fragen? Wir freuen uns auf deine Nachricht und helfen dir gerne weiter! DAS BIETEN WIR DIR Office Foodji: Immer bestens versorgt bei uns im Office bAV: Mit der Degura Pension Cloud sichern und bezuschussen wir jetzt schon deine Rente Spendit Card: Wir stocken dein Gehalt auf! Mit Spendit stehen dir bis zu fünfzig Euro netto im Monat on top zur freien Verfügung EGYM Wellpass: Mit uns bleibst du fit & wir bringen dich deutschlandweit in die angesagtesten Fitness- und Wellnessstudios JobRad: Spring mit uns aufs Rad und lease dir dein Traumrad oder Pedelec KITA/Kiga Kostenzuschuss: Wir bezuschussen deine Kosten für die Kinderbetreuung, damit deine Kinder immer bestens versorgt sind Mitarbeiterrabatte: Du erhältst attraktive Promotions und Discounts verschiedener Brands Food Tastings: Teste dich mit unserem Foodteam durch unsere Produkte und gestalte unser Sortiment von morgen Development: Deine Weiterentwicklung liegt uns am Herzen und mit regelmäßigen Feedbackgesprächen und Trainings bieten wir dir spannende Perspektiven! Flexwork: Arbeite 30 Tage im Jahr aus dem EU Ausland Top Office Lage: Genieße eine erstklassige Arbeitsumgebung im Münchener Glockenbachviertel mit der Isar vor der Tür Team Events: Wir sind ein Team - beim Skiday, Frühstück, Culture Week oder Office Party feiern wir gemeinsam! ÜBER UNS Hi, schön, dass du da bist! Wir sind Foodji - ein Team aus Food-Lovern & Tech-Nerds. Unsere Mission ist es, frisches, gesundes und vor allem leckeres Essen überall dort anzubieten, wo Menschen den Großteil ihres Alltags verbringen – in Büros, ganz gleich, ob im Gewerbegebiet oder mitten in der Stadt, während langer Schichten im Krankenhaus oder in den Tiefen einer Produktionshalle, in der rund um die Uhr Menschen arbeiten. Überall bieten wir vollwertige Gerichte, Snacks und Getränke genau dort an, wo und wann du sie brauchst. Proprietäre Technologien, selbstlernende Algorithmen und effiziente Lieferketten helfen uns dabei, das Paradox zwischen frischem Essen, Verfügbarkeit und Nachhaltigkeit aufzulösen. Mit unserer eigens entwickelten Technologieplattform optimieren wir die Mengenplanung und sagen Food Waste den Kampf an. Wir wollen einen positiven Effekt erzielen – auf die Umwelt, den Alltag unserer Kund:innen und unsere Communities. Deshalb spenden wir übrig gebliebene Gerichte an Foodsharing und andere soziale Initiativen direkt vor unserer Haustür. Als Marktführer versorgen wir mit Foodji bereits täglich Tausende Menschen in ganz Deutschland. Zu unseren Kund:innen zählen unter anderem der Münchner Flughafen, Klarna, Enpal und Wingcopter. Und wir fangen gerade erst an: Allein in Deutschland gibt es mehr als 100.000 relevante Standorte für uns. Trage auch du deinen Teil dazu bei und bewirb dich jetzt. Als Werkstudent*in Influencer Marketing DACH (m/w/d) unterstützt du uns beim Aufbau und der Skalierung von Influencer Kooperationen im DACH-Markt. Als Werkstudent*in Influencer Marketing DACH (m/w/d) bei everdrop werden das deine Hauptaufgaben sein: Du wirkst an der Entwicklung kreativer und authentischer Konzepte für Influencer-Marketing-Kampagnen mit. Du übernimmst die Kommunikation und Pflege unserer deutschen Influencer-Beziehungen (Beantwortung von Kooperationsanfragen, Verfassen von Texten und E-Mails) und verantwortest den Produkt- und Paketversand. Du recherchierst passende Kooperationspartner und betreust den gesamten Ablauf – vom Erstkontakt über Verhandlungen, Vertragsmanagement, Briefings und Performance-Analysen bis hin zum Beziehungsmanagement. Du unterstützt bei Monitoring, Dokumentation und Reporting der deutschen Influencer-Kooperationen. Du bist kontinuierlich auf der Suche nach spannenden Persönlichkeiten sowie neuen Kanälen (YouTube, TikTok, Podcasts), um unsere Kooperationen weiter auszubauen. Du stehst im ständigen Austausch mit unserem Marketing-Team, um gemeinsam strategische Ziele zu verfolgen. Du erstellst monatliche Newsletter für unsere Affiliate-Partner und unterstützt bei der Content-Erstellung für unsere deutschen TikTok- und Social-Media-Kanäle. DAS BIST DU Du hast Lust in einem Unternehmen zu arbeiten, das sich für einen nachhaltigeren Lifestyle einsetzt? Dann bist du bei uns genau richtig. Du übernimmst gerne Verantwortung von Tag 1, gehst Herausforderungen proaktiv an und fühlst dich in einem schnelllebigen und dynamischen Startup-Umfeld wohl? Wir glauben, das könnte ein gutes Match sein! Bei everdrop arbeiten Menschen mit Growth Mindset, die Lust darauf haben, immer wieder Neues zu lernen. Wenn du gerne eigene Ideen einbringst, Lust hast, Dinge von Beginn an mitzugestalten und die folgenden Skills und Erfahrungen mitbringst, könnte das der Anfang einer wunderbaren Love Story sein. Was wir suchen: Du absolvierst aktuell ein Bachelor- oder Masterstudium im Bereich Marketing, Medien- & Kommunikationswissenschaften, BWL oder einem vergleichbaren Studiengang. Du bist bereit, 16–20 Stunden pro Woche zu arbeiten. Dein Wohnort befindet sich im Raum München und du bringst die Bereitschaft mit, mindestens einmal pro Woche im Büro zu arbeiten. Idealerweise hast du bereits erste Erfahrungen im Influencer Marketing oder anderen Performance-Kanälen gesammelt. Du verfügst über Deutschkenntnisse auf muttersprachlichem Niveau sowie sehr gute Englischkenntnisse (mind. B2-Niveau). Empathie sowie exzellente schriftliche und mündliche Kommunikationsfähigkeiten zeichnen dich aus. Du bist ein Kommunikationstalent, arbeitest strukturiert und behältst auch in stressigen Phasen den Überblick. title: Senior Growth Product Manager
description: Data quality is the bottleneck of the AI era. Every Fortune 500 is trying to solve it. We're the team they call. Soda is the data quality layer for Disney, Ralph Lauren, CBRE, HelloFresh, 2K Games, and Nubank. Our open-source engine, Soda Core, is used by companies like Tesla, Slack, Adyen, Walmart, and JPMC. The category is growing fast because AI doesn't work on bad data, and we're hiring a Senior Growth Product Manager to get customers using Soda faster and on more of their data. About Us Soda's mission is to monitor the world's decisions. We're building the first Data & AI performance monitoring platform that spans data collection to automated decision-making. Soda helps customers find, understand, and fix data quality issues by combining automated post-production monitoring with pre-production pipeline data testing. Soda was founded in 2019 by Maarten (employee #5 at Collibra) and Tom (creator of multiple open-source projects generating hundreds of millions in value). We commercialize through Soda Cloud and we're well-funded, with investors like Point 9 Capital, Hummingbird, Singular, and Eurazeo. The Role You'll lead our adoption team, a small group of frontend, full-stack, and AI engineers. The team works on onboarding and activation, on keeping workflows coherent across the product, on customer-facing dashboards, and on AI features that save users work. Most of our roadmap is driven by what customers and prospects ask for. This team's work is driven by adoption metrics, because customers rarely ask for the things that would make them use Soda more. You'll start from a hypothesis, for example that changing a flow will get 20% more data contracts created, ship the change, and check whether it worked. We sell to enterprises, so sample sizes are small and A/B tests rarely reach significance. You'll use product analytics, session replays, and conversations with users, and you'll often have to decide with incomplete data. This is a product role. If most of your growth experience is in paid acquisition or lifecycle email, it's probably the wrong fit. You'll also work closely with our Growth team, which is led by a co-founder, on launches and messaging. What You'll Do Own the adoption metrics for Soda Cloud: time to first verified contract for new accounts, data coverage (datasets with contracts and monitors), weekly active datasets and users, and usage of AI features. You'll define them, make sure we can measure them, and improve them. Own the UX of workflows across the product and keep them coherent for our two kinds of users: data engineers, and business users such as data stewards and governance leads. Find where customers get stuck between signing the contract and running Soda on most of their data, and decide what to fix first. Design and ship onboarding flows that get a new team to first value within days, including self-serve paths for technical teams that want to evaluate Soda on their own. Put AI to work on adoption: decide which steps an agent should do for the user, ship them with the team, and measure whether people keep using them. Work with Growth on launches and product marketing, and with our customer engineers on whatever is blocking rollouts at customers. Hiring Process Application: your CV, plus a short answer about one metric you moved (what it was, what you shipped, what happened, and what didn't work) 15-minute phone screen First interview (60 min): a deep dive into product growth work you've done. Part of it is showing us something you shipped that you'd still be proud to demo. Second interview (60 min): a working session on a real Soda adoption problem Culture fit (45 min) We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly. Requirements You Should Have 5+ years in product, including at least 2 owning growth, activation, onboarding, or adoption in B2B SaaS : you were accountable for a metric for long enough to see whether your changes worked. In your application, tell us which metric it was, where it started and where it ended, what you shipped, and what didn't work. Product craft and taste : you love software and have used a lot of it yourself, so you know what a good product feels like. You keep scope small, work in short cycles with engineers and designers, run your own customer calls, and have well-reasoned opinions about UX. An AI-native way of working and building : you've shipped an AI-powered feature and measured whether people use it, you prototype with coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.), and you're happy to open a small PR yourself for something like a copy change. You do your own analysis : you write SQL, build funnels yourself, and know when a sample is too small to conclude anything. Experience with technical products : you've built for engineers or data teams and are comfortable talking about pipelines, warehouses, and APIs. Clear writing and comfort working async : we're a distributed team across 12+ countries, and most decisions happen in writing, in English. The five years don't all have to be in a PM role. If you were a product engineer or a founder and owned a growth metric, please apply. Good to Have Data quality, data observability, data governance, or data infrastructure experience. Experience with product-led growth at a company that also sells to enterprises. Experience with Shape Up or another fixed-time, variable-scope way of working. Benefits What We Offer Compensation €120,000–140,000/year + equity. Outside Belgium, this is a contractor position. Fully remote (EU-based), with a Belgian office available if you want one. In-person kickoffs every two months in cool locations across Europe, three days with the whole product and engineering team. All the tokens you need, across all frontier models. Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement. A senior team that ships, across 12+ countries. Our Values We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions. ❤️ Why you will love to join Soda You own the adoption metrics : you decide how we measure adoption and what we do to improve it. Lots of room to improve : we already have enterprise customers and usage data, and we've done very little growth work so far. Your own engineering team : you'll work with dedicated engineers who build agentically, so your ideas get shipped quickly. Be part of a transformation : data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it. Work on your own terms : fully remote, flexible hours, colleagues in 12+ countries. 😡 What you might not love Rapidly changing priorities : our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done. Small numbers : we have relatively few accounts and feedback is slow. If you're used to deciding from consumer-scale data, you may find that frustrating. No playbook : this is the first dedicated growth PM role at Soda.   • Find where customers get stuck between signing the contract and running Soda on most of their data, and decide what to fix first.
  • Design and ship onboarding flows that get a new team to first value within days, including self-serve paths for technical teams that want to evaluate Soda on their own.
  • Put AI to work on adoption: decide which steps an agent should do for the user, ship them with the team, and measure whether people keep using them.
  • Work with Growth on launches and product marketing, and with our customer engineers on whatever is blocking rollouts at customers.

Hiring Process

  1. Application: your CV, plus a short answer about one metric you moved (what it was, what you shipped, what happened, and what didn't work)
  2. 15-minute phone screen
  3. First interview (60 min): a deep dive into product growth work you've done. Part of it is showing us something you shipped that you'd still be proud to demo.
  4. Second interview (60 min): a working session on a real Soda adoption problem
  5. Culture fit (45 min)

We answer every application, and every candidate hears back within 3–5 days of each step. If it's not a hell yes, it's a no, and we'll tell you quickly and kindly.

Requirements

You Should Have

  • 5+ years in product, including at least 2 owning growth, activation, onboarding, or adoption in B2B SaaS: you were accountable for a metric for long enough to see whether your changes worked. In your application, tell us which metric it was, where it started and where it ended, what you shipped, and what didn't work.
  • Product craft and taste: you love software and have used a lot of it yourself, so you know what a good product feels like. You keep scope small, work in short cycles with engineers and designers, run your own customer calls, and have well-reasoned opinions about UX.
  • An AI-native way of working and building: you've shipped an AI-powered feature and measured whether people use it, you prototype with coding agents (Claude Code, Codex, etc.), and you're happy to open a small PR yourself for something like a copy change.
  • You do your own analysis: you write SQL, build funnels yourself, and know when a sample is too small to conclude anything.
  • Experience with technical products: you've built for engineers or data teams and are comfortable talking about pipelines, warehouses, and APIs.
  • Clear writing and comfort working async: we're a distributed team across 12+ countries, and most decisions happen in writing, in English.

The five years don't all have to be in a PM role. If you were a product engineer or a founder and owned a growth metric, please apply.

Good to Have

  • Data quality, data observability, data governance, or data infrastructure experience.
  • Experience with product-led growth at a company that also sells to enterprises.
  • Experience with Shape Up or another fixed-time, variable-scope way of working.

Benefits

What We Offer

  • Compensation €120,000–140,000/year + equity.
  • Outside Belgium, this is a contractor position.
  • Fully remote (EU-based), with a Belgian office available if you want one.
  • In-person kickoffs every two months in cool locations across Europe, three days with the whole product and engineering team.
  • All the tokens you need, across all frontier models.
  • Real ownership, real impact, no micromanagement.
  • A senior team that ships, across 12+ countries.

Our Values

We value freedom with responsibility, transparency, and a growth mindset. We avoid politics, have no tolerance for dishonesty, and value open and direct communication without judgment. We proactively bring up and address potential issues before they become critical, and we overcommunicate frequently. Working at Soda, you will have full autonomy to make impactful product and roadmap decisions.

❤️ Why you will love to join Soda

  • You own the adoption metrics: you decide how we measure adoption and what we do to improve it.
  • Lots of room to improve: we already have enterprise customers and usage data, and we've done very little growth work so far.
  • Your own engineering team: you'll work with dedicated engineers who build agentically, so your ideas get shipped quickly.
  • Be part of a transformation: data quality is having its moment, and we're at the front of it.
  • Work on your own terms: fully remote, flexible hours, colleagues in 12+ countries.

😡 What you might not love

  • Rapidly changing priorities: our roadmap can pivot quickly. It's a fast-paced environment with a LOT of work to be done.
  • Small numbers: we have relatively few accounts and feedback is slow. If you're used to deciding from consumer-scale data, you may find that frustrating.
  • No playbook: this is the first dedicated growth PM role at Soda.
