title: Kundenberater / Kundenbetreuer (m/w/d) – Service mit Persönlichkeit
description: Du liebst persönlichen Kundenkontakt. Bei uns verbindest du ihn mit internationalen Aufgaben und der Chance, beruflich weiterzukommen. Wir sind Akademis, eine mehrfach ausgezeichnete Bildungsberatung. Wir helfen Familien, das passende Internat im Ausland für ihr Kind zu finden, und begleiten sie bei den nächsten Schritten. Für unser neues Büro in Berlin-Frohnau suchen wir jemanden, der gerne telefoniert, aufmerksam zuhört und Freude daran hat, sich persönlich um Menschen zu kümmern. Unsere Familien vertrauen uns eine wichtige Entscheidung an. Sie schätzen eine Ansprechperson, die ihre Wünsche kennt, verständlich erklärt und zuverlässig nachfasst. Genau das lieben wir an unserer Arbeit: wenn aus einem ersten Gespräch eine vertraute Zusammenarbeit wird und Eltern wissen, dass sie sich auf uns verlassen können. Vielleicht arbeitest du bisher in der Hotellerie, in der Gästebetreuung oder im Kundenservice und möchtest deine Erfahrung in einem neuen Umfeld einsetzen. Bei uns bist du als Quereinsteiger herzlich willkommen. Noch wichtiger als ein perfekter Lebenslauf sind uns deine Persönlichkeit, deine Verlässlichkeit und deine Freude daran, Familien und junge Menschen zu begleiten. Du möchtest dich einbringen und beruflich weiterkommen? Wir arbeiten dich persönlich ein und unterstützen dich dabei, deine eigenen Familien zunehmend selbstständig zu betreuen. In unserem kleinen Team kannst du Abläufe mitgestalten und mehr Verantwortung übernehmen. Mit deiner fachlichen Entwicklung und guten Leistungen soll sich auch dein Gehalt weiterentwickeln Aufgaben Familien beraten und von Anfang bis Ende begleiten: Du lernst Eltern und Jugendliche kennen, berätst Interessierte zu unserem Angebot und betreust deine Familien während der Vorbereitung und des Internatsaufenthalts bis zur Rückkehr. Du hörst aufmerksam zu, gehst auf individuelle Wünsche ein und hältst von dir aus Kontakt – telefonisch und per E-Mail. Bewerbungen, Schulbesuche und Termine organisieren: Du koordinierst Bewerbungsunterlagen, Schulbesuche und die Vorbereitung auf Aufnahmeverfahren. Du pflegst Kundendaten sorgfältig, behältst Fristen im Blick und fasst selbstständig nach, wenn Unterlagen oder Rückmeldungen fehlen. Deine Familien wissen, welche Schritte als Nächstes anstehen. Beziehungen zu internationalen Partnerschulen pflegen: Du kommunizierst auf Englisch mit unseren Partnerschulen, klärst Fragen und stimmst Anforderungen und Abläufe ab. Dabei baust du persönliche Kontakte und eine vertrauensvolle Zusammenarbeit auf. Eigene Projekte gestalten und umsetzen: Du übernimmst Projekte von der Planung bis zum Abschluss, bringst Ideen ein und verbesserst gemeinsam mit uns Abläufe. Ziele und Zuständigkeiten legen wir zusammen fest. Profil Du übernimmst Verantwortung: Du hältst Zusagen ein, bringst Aufgaben nach der Einarbeitung eigenständig zum Abschluss und sprichst Schwierigkeiten frühzeitig an. Du denkst mit und packst an: Du erkennst, wo dein Beitrag gebraucht wird, unterstützt dein Team und möchtest unser kleines Unternehmen aktiv mitgestalten. Eigene Ideen bringst du ein und hilfst dabei, sie umzusetzen. Du gehst neue Herausforderungen offen an: Du arbeitest dich engagiert in neue Themen ein, stellst gezielte Fragen und entwickelst deine Fähigkeiten weiter. Du verbindest Sorgfalt mit Tempo: Du arbeitest konzentriert und zügig, setzt Prioritäten und behältst parallele Anliegen im Blick. Du verstehst ihre Wünsche, präsentierst Produkte und Zubehör und empfiehlst die passende Lösung für ihren Außenbereich. Dabei betreust du deine Kundenkontakte eigenverantwortlich, fasst Angebote verbindlich nach und gestaltest mit, wie Kund PERGOLUX in unserem Flagship Store erleben.

PERGOLUX entwirft und verkauft skandinavisch inspirierte Outdoor-Living-Produkte wie Pergolen und Gartenmöbel direkt an Endkund. Mit rund 300 Mitarbeiter, einem neunstelligen Umsatz und Aktivitäten in acht Märkten sind wir über die Jahre stetig gewachsen – in Europa und darüber hinaus.

Deine Aufgaben

  • Kund:innen beraten: Du findest heraus, was unsere Kund für ihren Außenbereich brauchen, und empfiehlst passende Pergolen, Ausstattungsvarianten und Zubehör.

  • Produkte erlebbar machen: Du führst unsere Produkte im Flagship Store vor und erklärst Funktionen, Materialien und Maße verständlich und anschaulich.

  • Abschlüsse erzielen: Du erstellst Angebote, klärst Rückfragen und fasst verbindlich nach – persönlich, telefonisch und per E-Mail. Deine Verkaufsgespräche begleitest du eigenverantwortlich bis zum Abschluss.

  • Den Überblick behalten: Du dokumentierst Kundenwünsche, Angebote, Termine und nächste Schritte im CRM und hältst vereinbarte Rückmeldungen zuverlässig ein.

  • Mit anpacken: Du hältst den Flagship Store gepflegt und vorführbereit, bringst Ideen für die Produktpräsentation ein und unterstützt Verkaufsaktionen.

Dein Profil

  • Freude am Verkauf: Du gehst offen auf Menschen zu, hörst aufmerksam zu und überzeugst mit Lösungen, die zu ihren Bedürfnissen passen.

  • Passende Erfahrung: Idealerweise bringst du Erfahrung im beratungsintensiven Verkauf mit – etwa mit Terrassenüberdachungen, Fenstern, Türen, Wintergärten, Bauelementen, Möbeln oder Küchen.

  • Technisches Verständnis: Du kannst mit Maßen, Materialien und Produktdetails umgehen und möchtest dir fundiertes Wissen über unsere Pergolen aneignen.

  • Eigenverantwortung und Kommunikationsstärke: Du organisierst deine Aufgaben zuverlässig, bleibst an Kundenanfragen dran, kommunizierst sicher auf Deutsch und findest dich in digitalen Tools zurecht.

  • Motivation für den Quereinstieg: Du kommst aus dem Handwerk und möchtest deine Erfahrung in die Kundenberatung einbringen? Freude am Verkauf und Lernbereitschaft sind dafür eine gute Grundlage.

💼 Vergütung

  • Attraktives Gehalt, das deine Erfahrung berücksichtigt und Verkaufserfolge honoriert

  • Betriebliche Altersvorsorge

🚀 Einarbeitung und Entwicklung

  • Fundierte Einarbeitung in Produkte und Verkauf, damit du sicher beraten kannst – auch als Quereinsteiger

  • Eigenverantwortliche Betreuung deiner Kundenkontakte und direkter Einfluss auf den Verkaufserfolg des Flagship Stores

  • Die Möglichkeit, unseren Flagship Store von Beginn an mitzugestalten und eigene Ideen einzubringen

  • Zusammenarbeit und Austausch mit Kolleg in ganz Europa

  • Die Perspektive, mit PERGOLUX zu wachsen und künftig mehr Verantwortung bis hin zu Führungsaufgaben zu übernehmen

⏰ Arbeitszeit und Urlaub

  • Teilzeitmodell: 20 bis 30 Stunden pro Woche (nach Absprache)

  • 27 Urlaubstage, steigend auf bis zu 30

🌟 Benefits

  • Moderne Ausstattung für deinen Arbeitsalltag

  • Mitarbeiterrabatte auf PERGOLUX-Produkte

  • JobRad / Bike-Leasing für nachhaltiges und gesundes Pendeln

So bewirbst du dich

Klingt nach dir? Dann bewirb dich mit deinem Lebenslauf über unsere Karriereseite. Weitere Einblicke in unser Team und den Arbeitsalltag bei PERGOLUX findest du auf LinkedIn.

PERGOLUX steht für Chancengleichheit. Wir begrüßen Menschen mit unterschiedlichen Hintergründen und Erfahrungen. Du erfüllst noch nicht jedes Kriterium? Bewirb dich trotzdem – für uns zählen deine Fähigkeiten, deine Motivation und deine Bereitschaft, Neues zu lernen.

title: Copywriter
description: As a Copywriter (m/w/d), you will own the words behind PERGOLUX campaigns across our global markets, writing and editing copy for Meta, Google, email, and web that turns product benefits into clear, persuasive messaging. You will shape headlines, product descriptions, campaign concepts, and calls to action, adapting tone and messaging for different audiences, languages, and cultural contexts while keeping brand voice consistent. Working closely with marketing, product, e-commerce, and sales colleagues, you will drive copy quality from first draft through hands-on editing and testing. PERGOLUX designs and sells Scandinavian-inspired outdoor living products, from pergolas to garden furniture, directly to consumers. We are a company that has grown consistently across Europe and beyond, with around 300 employees, 9-figure revenue, and operations spanning 8 markets. What You'll Do - Write and edit copy for Meta, Google, email, web, and other marketing channels, developing compelling headlines, product descriptions, and calls to action. - Optimise copy for Meta and Google campaigns, testing different messaging angles and calls to action to improve campaign performance. - Support the product page redesign process with clear, conversion-focused copy that communicates key benefits and improves the user experience. - Adapt messaging across multiple markets, languages, and cultural nuances while keeping brand voice and tone consistent through hands-on quality checks. - Collaborate with global and local teams across marketing, product, e-commerce, and sales to deliver effective, on-brand communication. What You'll Bring - 5+ years of copywriting experience with a strong portfolio of high-quality work for digital marketing channels, including paid ads, email, web, and social media. - Excellent writing, editing, and proofreading skills in English, with a strong eye for detail, accuracy, and consistency. - A solid grasp of brand voice, storytelling, and persuasive messaging, plus copywriting best practices like SEO, readability, and conversion-focused writing. - The ability to manage multiple projects and deadlines in a fast-paced environment, staying organised and process-oriented. - Nice to have: experience with AI writing tools and localisation workflows, familiarity with Jira, Figma, and Canva, and knowledge of a European language beyond English or German (e.g. Swedish, French, Italian). 💼 Compensation — Competitive salary · Company pension plan · Capped overtime, fully paid, no endless unpaid crunch 🚀 Growth and Career Development — You will take real ownership of your work from the start with direct impact on campaign and business outcomes, work alongside an international team across Europe, and follow fast-track opportunities to grow into senior roles as PERGOLUX scales. ⏰ Time Off and Flexibility — Up to 30 vacation days, starting at 27 · One week per year remote workation in the EU/UK 🌟 Benefits and Lifestyle - Team culture with regular team events (summer party, Christmas party, after-work gatherings) and retreats - Modern setup and laptops (Apple or Windows) - Employee discounts on PERGOLUX products - Jobrad / Bike leasing program, promoting sustainable and healthy commuting 📍 Office Location – Schlesische Str. 27 C, Building C, 6th floor, 10997 Berlin How to Apply Ready to shape the words behind our campaigns? Apply through our [Career Page]( https://pergolux.careers/ ) or connect with us on [LinkedIn]( https://www.linkedin.com/company/pergolux/posts/?feedView=all ). PERGOLUX is an equal opportunity employer. We welcome applicants from all backgrounds, we think it's less about ticking every box and more about what you bring to the table! title: Support Systems & Programs Lead | Europe Remote
description: The AI orchestration of your wildest imagination. n8n is the open workflow orchestration platform built for the new era of AI. We give technical teams the freedom of code with the speed of no-code, so they can automate faster, smarter, and without limits. Backed by a fiercely inventive community and 500+ builder-approved integrations, we’re changing the way people bring systems together and scale ideas for impact. Since our founding in 2019, we’ve grown into a diverse team of over 260 - working across Europe and the US, connected by a shared builder spirit and with our centre of gravity in Berlin. Along the way, we’ve: Cultivated a community of more than 650,000 active developers and builders Earned 190K+ GitHub stars, making us one of the world’s Top 40 most popular projects Backed by top investors, from Sequoia’s first German seed to our SAP's recent strategic investment - bringing us to a $5.2bn valuation That’s the company we’ve built. Now we’d love to see what you can build. If you’re applying, try n8n out - whether you’re technical or not - and share a screenshot of your first workflow with us. The easiest place to start is here: app.n8n.cloud/register . We’re in a defining moment of an incredible journey. Come and build with us. Your main goal will be to build and scale the systems, automations, and AI-powered processes that enable n8n's Support teams to deliver exceptional service at scale , while leading and developing the engineers who make it happen. To achieve this, you'll take ownership of four key areas: Lead and grow the Support Systems team Lead, coach, and develop our Systems & Programs engineers, helping them grow their technical expertise and careers. Establish a clear team scope, planning processes, and delivery rhythm to ensure consistent execution against priorities. Support hiring and onboarding while staying close to technical decisions and hands-on problem-solving. Own the Support tooling strategy and roadmap Own the Support tooling portfolio and build a prioritised roadmap that enables Reactive and Proactive Support to scale efficiently. Establish structured project intake, scoping, and prioritisation processes to focus engineering efforts on the highest-impact opportunities. Partner with Support leaders and stakeholders across Product, Engineering, Cloud, Security, Legal, Data, Customer Success, Sales, and Partnerships to align priorities and deliver improvements. Drive AI-first Support and automation Lead the expansion of Nate, our AI-powered Support solution, across Support tiers to increase the share of tickets handled through AI. Guide the development, maintenance, and adoption of reliable automations, AI agents, and integrations that reduce repetitive work and improve Support efficiency. Measure the impact of AI and automation through metrics such as time saved, AI-handled ticket share, and cost per AI ticket. Build scalable processes and operational foundations Rebuild and optimise foundational Support processes, ensuring workflows are efficient, documented, and scalable. Establish strong governance for standard operating procedures (SOPs), tooling ownership, and automation reliability. Drive continuous improvement by tracking tooling adoption, SOP compliance, operational efficiency, and capacity freed up for Support teams. REQUIREMENTS Must-haves Hands-on n8n expertise: You have practical experience building and maintaining complex workflows and automations using n8n. Strong technical foundations: You're comfortable working with APIs, HTTP, authentication, webhooks, and SaaS architecture. Support systems ownership: You've owned and improved technical Support systems, tooling, and automations in a B2B SaaS environment. Engineering leadership: You have at least 5 years experience leading or mentoring engineers, helping them develop their skills and deliver high-quality work. Roadmap and stakeholder management: You can translate business needs into clear technical priorities and align cross-functional stakeholders around a shared roadmap. AI and automation expertise: You have hands-on experience implementing AI agents or AI-assisted Support tooling to improve operational efficiency. Nice-to-haves Technical product background: You've worked as a developer, in DevOps, or on an automation-focused technical product. Support analytics: You're familiar with Support performance metrics and have experience using analytics or dashboarding tools such as Hex or Metabase. Open-source ecosystem: You have experience working in open-source or community-led SaaS environments. Remote-first experience: You've worked in distributed, remote-first teams, ideally within a European startup or scale-up. Why join us? At n8n, you'll have the opportunity to shape a growing Support Systems function and define how we scale customer support through AI, automation, and better tooling. You'll lead a team of talented engineers, own a high-impact technical roadmap, and work closely with teams across the company to turn ambitious ideas into real operational improvements. You'll join one of Europe's fastest-growing startups, where your work will directly influence how we deliver exceptional customer experiences as we grow. With a remote-first culture that values autonomy, experimentation, and continuous learning, you'll have the freedom to build the foundations of an AI-first Support organisation. Sound like a challenge you're excited to take on? Apply now — and help us build the future of automation. n8n is an equal opportunity employer and does not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, gender identity, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We can sponsor visas to Germany; for any other country, you need to have existing right to work. Our company language is English. You care about diversity and inclusion? We do too! Check out our Diversity, Inclusion and Belonging initiatives at n8n ( https://www.notion.so/n8n/Diversity-inclusion-and-belonging-n8n-c1bec2fff536422d868b1a438d990e35 ). Location disclaimer: If you see multiple job postings for the same role, it is most likely because we're hiring remotely for this role and posting in different locations to make sure every potential candidate can see the role. Please apply to the location you're the most likely to work from in the future. Benefits Competitive compensation 💸 – We offer fair and attractive pay. Ownership 💪 – Our core value is to “empower others,” and we mean it—you’ll get a slice of n8n with equity. Work/life balance 🏖️ – We work hard but ensure you have time to recharge: Europe: 30 days of vacation, plus public holidays wherever you are. US: 20 vacation days, 8 sick days, plus public holidays wherever you are. Health & wellness 🩺 – Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.* US : Multiple low-premium, low-deductible medical plans with coverage for individuals and families—plus a no-cost premium HDHP option with a pre-seeded HSA—along with dental and vision coverage. Future planning 💰 – Europe: We provide pension contributions according to local country norms.* US: 401(k) retirement plan with a 4% employer match. Financial security 🛡️ – Europe: We provide benefits according to local country norms.* US: Company-paid short-term and long-term disability insurance, plus life insurance to support you and your loved ones. Career growth 📈 – We hire rising stars who grow with us! You’ll get €1K (or equivalent) per year to spend on courses, books, events, or coaching to level up your skills. A passionate team 🤩 – We love our product, and we prove it with regular hackathons where we see who can build the coolest thing with it! Remote-first 🌏 – Our team works remotely across Europe, with regular off-sites for team bonding. Some roles, like sales in the US, are hybrid—please check the job description. Giving back 🤝 – We're big fans of open source, and you'll get $100 per month to support projects you care about. Transparency 🙏 – We all know what everyone’s working on, how the company is doing—the whole shebang. *Country and/or State specific details provided in your employment agreement. Staff Backend Engineer - Operations Tech Team

Hybrid in London, UK

We’re looking for a Staff Backend Engineer to join the Operations Tech team.

You’ll influence the technical direction of iwoca’s in-house CRM and build parts of it yourself – the system that hundreds of staff across sales, account management, credit, and collections use to give our customers five-star service.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The team

The Operations Tech team builds the tools iwoca’s UK operations teams use every day: the CRM, and the systems behind phone calls, emails, notifications, and task management. Those tools are a competitive advantage – they help colleagues manage risk and enable the outstanding customer service that sets iwoca apart.

The team works closely with the Operations Strategy team, which sets operational priorities and scopes much of the tooling. Many of its users work in the same building, and you’ll see how your changes affect the people you work with.

We’re growing the team to ten engineers (including this role), two of them tech leads, and two product owners. Most of its time goes on quarterly roadmap projects, alongside a support rota, and regular small feature improvements.

The role

As a staff backend engineer, you’ll take whole projects end to end: work out what operations teams need, design it, build it, and look after it in production. You’ll decide with the tech leads where the CRM’s service boundaries sit and how to model each domain’s data. You’ll judge your work by what it changes for those teams and their customers.

This is a hands-on individual contributor role with no line management, but you’ll mentor the engineers around you. You’ll often pair with a more junior engineer, share what you know, and set the standards the team works to through design discussions and code review.

You’ll learn how iwoca lends, from credit decisions to collections and financial crime. The team is adding AI to the CRM’s workflows, and you’ll have a say in where it helps.

Live project examples:

  • Migrating the monolith. Moving CRM functionality out of iwoca’s Django monolith into separate services, such as customer contact and phone calls, that deploy and scale on their own.

  • Building customer-facing AI agents to take the load off our teams as we grow, and the infrastructure to make them reliable and trustworthy

  • Improving our onboarding journey to so that there’s less manual work getting a customer their funds, for example using LLMs to speed up compliance checks

  • Credit card operations. Building the CRM services that let operations teams support customers on iwoca’s business credit card.

  • iwocaChat. Extending the Claude-powered assistant that answers operations staff questions about a customer, using data held across several systems.

The requirements

Essential:

  • System design. You’ve designed large production systems and the domain models at their core, and changed their architecture while people relied on them.

  • Backend engineering. You have deep expertise in at least one object-oriented language. You’ve written and run backend services in it.

  • Technical leadership. You’ve led technical decisions across a team as an individual contributor, and helped other engineers grow through code reviews and design sessions.

  • Operational problems. You’ve worked with non-technical colleagues to understand a problem they had, and built the system that solved it.

  • AI leverage. You’ve built agentic workflows, or used AI to scale your engineering output beyond what you could deliver alone. You judge when to use it and when not to, and you check its output before it reaches production.

  • Communication. You write and speak clearly, directly, and concisely. You adapt technical detail to your audience.

Bonus:

  • Python stack. You’ve worked with Python, Django, Celery, and PostgreSQL.

  • Full-stack. You’ve contributed to frontend codebases, particularly in React or TypeScript.

  • Monolith migration. You’ve moved functionality out of a large monolith into separate services, while both stayed in production.

  • Asynchronous systems. You’ve built services that communicate through message queues such as RabbitMQ.

  • Contact systems. You’ve worked on telephony, email, or messaging systems, such as Twilio.

  • Models in production systems. You’ve built systems that use model outputs to make operational decisions, such as which work to prioritise.

The salary

We expect to pay from £100,000 to £130,000 for this role. But, we're open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

raw.description:
Tech Lead - Shared Backend Services

Hybrid in London (UK) or Remote within the UK

We’re looking for a Tech Lead to join the Funnel Platform team.

You’ll lead the team behind the shared services and frameworks that iwoca’s engineers build on. Those engineers are your customers, and the shared backend services feed iwoca’s lending decisions.

The company

Small businesses move fast. Opportunities often don’t wait, and cash flow pressures can appear overnight. To keep going, and growing, SMEs need finance that’s as flexible and responsive as they are.

That's why we built iwoca. Our smart technology, data science and five-star customer service ensures business owners can act with the speed, confidence and control they need, exactly when it's needed.

We’ve already cleared the way for 100,000 businesses with more than £4 billion in funding. Our passionate team is driven to help even more SMEs succeed, through access to better finance and other services that make running a business easier. Our ultimate mission is to support one million SMEs in their defining moments, creating lasting impact for the communities and economies they drive.

The Team

Funnel Platform takes its name from iwoca’s customer funnel – a business’s journey from first application to repeat lending. It owns the shared services and frameworks that the customer journey teams along that funnel build on, in the UK and Germany. The team’s aim is to make those services reliable, and simple for other teams to change.

The team works across three areas:

  • Credit data. Looking after the services that bring in data from the UK credit bureaus and Companies House.

  • Bank data. Looking after the service other teams use to work with business bank transactions.

  • New shared services. Building services that several teams need, including one for split tests.

The team is small – three backend engineers, including you. Infrastructure, such as Kubernetes and cloud hosting, sits with a separate team, so the work here is software.

The Role

As the Tech Lead in Funnel Platform, you’ll stay hands-on in the code while you lead the team. The team has no product manager, so you’ll decide what it builds, with input on priorities from the leaders of iwoca’s customer journey teams. You’ll report to the head of engineering for the customer journey teams.

  • Ownership. You’ll be accountable for the team’s existing services and the new ones it builds, from design to production.

  • Engineering standards. You’ll shape how the team designs and tests the shared services, and review the changes other teams make to them.

  • Impact. You’ll improve the services iwoca’s customer journey teams depend on, so your work speeds up theirs.

  • Influence. You’ll use data to persuade the customer journey teams and their leaders to back shared-service work that helps all of them.

  • Leadership and growth. You’ll line-manage the team’s two engineers, and give them the guidance and context to lead projects of their own.

The requirements

Essential:

  • Technical leadership. You’ve led engineers as a tech lead for around two years, while staying hands-on in the code.

  • Shared services. You’ve built and run backend services or frameworks that other engineering teams use and contribute to. You’ve reviewed their changes and shaped how they use your work.

  • Backend engineering. You know at least one backend language in depth, and you’ve designed and run distributed systems in production.

  • Problem finding. You’ve set a team’s priorities without a product manager, talking to the people who use your work to find the real problem before you design a fix. You can show what a technical trade-off costs or saves the business.

  • AI leverage. You’ve used AI to produce work you couldn’t have delivered without it – such as an internal tool or a migration. You know where it helps keep shared code easy to maintain, and you review what it produces before it goes live.

Bonus:

  • Python and Django. You’ve built production services in Python with Django.

  • Numerical background. You’re comfortable analysing data and drawing conclusions you can defend.

  • Experimentation. You’ve built tools that other teams use to run split tests.

  • Fintech. You’ve worked at a fintech or another financial services business.

The salary

We expect to pay from £100,000 to £130,000 for this role. But, we’re open-minded, so definitely include your salary goals with your application. We routinely benchmark salaries against market rates, and run quarterly performance and salary reviews.

The culture

At iwoca, the best idea wins. We model our culture on independent thinking, challenging untested logic, and evidence-based decisions. We prioritise learning and growth, and give people the autonomy to develop in the direction that makes them most effective.

We're a tech company and believe in the power of AI to help us work faster and better. We provide the infrastructure where every iwocan always has access to the best models and where those models have access to all of our data. We will help our people to learn how to use and grow with the new tools available to them.

The offices

We put a lot of effort into making iwoca a great place to work:

  • Offices in London, Leeds, Berlin, and Frankfurt with plenty of drinks and snacks.

  • Events and community-led groups, including running groups, padel, and monthly ping-pong and pool competitions.

The benefits

  • Flexible working hours.

  • Medical insurance from Vitality, including discounted gym membership.

  • A private GP service (separate from Vitality) for you, your partner, and your dependents.

  • 25 days’ holiday per year, an extra day off for your birthday, the option to buy or sell an additional five days of annual leave, and unlimited unpaid leave.

  • A one-month, fully paid sabbatical after four years.

  • Instant access to external counselling and therapy sessions for team members that need emotional or mental health support.

  • 3% Pension contributions on total earnings.

  • An employee equity incentive scheme.

  • Generous parental leave and a nursery tax benefit scheme to help you save money.

  • Electric car scheme and cycle to work scheme.

  • Two company retreats a year: we’ve been to France, Italy, Spain, and further afield.

And to make sure we all keep learning, we offer:

  • A learning and development budget for everyone.

  • Company-wide talks with internal and external speakers.

  • Access to learning platforms like Treehouse.

description: What is Sylvera anyway? ‍👩‍👨🌳 Sylvera helps organisations make confident decisions in carbon and commodity markets. We independently assess the quality of carbon projects, track market pricing and supply signals, and provide geospatial and carbon intensity data — giving our clients the clarity they need to invest in real climate action. We're a team of 130+ scientists, engineers, and market experts based across London, New York, São Paulo, Singapore, and Tokyo. Our work spans market intelligence, geospatial analytics, multi-scale lidar research, and policy analysis. We partner with governments and policymakers to raise the bar for transparency and rigour across carbon markets. Backed by over $96 million from investors including Fidelity, Balderton Capital, Index Ventures, and Insight Partners, we're trusted by Fortune 500 companies, major financial institutions, and governments worldwide. If you care about climate, enjoy solving hard problems, and want to work with people who take the mission seriously — we'd love to hear from you. What will I be doing? ‍‍ 👩‍💻👨‍💻 We’re looking for a mission-driven Site Reliability Engineer to join the Apps & Platform team in Engineering. You'll bring security and compliance into how we build and run our AWS platform every day, not just at audit time, and you'll do it hands-on in the infrastructure. Specific responsibilities will include: Running the technical side of our ISO 27001 programme. You'll keep our controls passing in Drata, collect evidence from AWS, GitHub and our identity tools, and fix what fails yourself. Hardening and running our AWS estate with the platform team: IAM and SSO, networking and firewalling, encryption, secrets, backups and disaster recovery, all in Terraform. Owning vulnerability management across engineering. You'll triage findings from Aikido and our annual penetration test, and work with product teams to get them fixed. Making our systems observable and our incident response sharp: alerting in Datadog and Sentry, on-call, postmortems, and runbooks/skills people actually use. We’re looking for someone who: 🧠💚 Has run production infrastructure on AWS and writes Terraform comfortably Has hands-on experience with a security framework such as ISO 27001 or SOC 2: you've owned controls and produced the evidence Has sound security instincts and knows when a risk is worth accepting Has been on call, worked real incidents, and made things better afterwards Weighs cost and complexity, and picks the simplest thing that works at our scale Meets an unfamiliar problem with "I'll find out", whether it's a CIDR clash, a failing control or a vendor console you've never opened Ideally knows their way around Kubernetes (EKS), Linux and network debugging, identity and device management (e.g. JumpCloud), and AI coding agents in infrastructure work Is a self-starter who thrives in constantly evolving environments, ideally with early-stage experience We’d like someone highly ambitious, motivated and eager to propel their career forward. We prioritise grit, positivity, and the willingness to get stuck in, and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match this job description. Benefits 💰 Equity in a rapidly growing startup Private Health Insurance and Life Assurance Unlimited annual leave - we hold Sylverans to account based on outcome rather than inputs Enhanced parental leave Local bar tab at the end of the month Weekly drinks in the office Catered lunch once a month in office Monthly Deliveroo/equivalent allowance once a month Location 🌍 London, UK (hybrid). We work flexibly whilst encouraging people to come in regularly to our great office in Old St Our Values 🙌 Own it: We build on the momentum of our wins and reflect on and learn from our failures. Stay curious: We keep our focus on the long-term, even if that means short-term challenges. Do what’s right - even when it’s hard: We take a growth mindset to our work, our customers, our market and the opportunities ahead of us. Collaborate and challenge with empathy: Our teams deliver through active collaboration. We invest in each others’ success and make the company stronger in the long-run. Empower Customers: Make extraordinary efforts to exceed our customer expectations. If we’re serving our customers to the fullest, we can help direct more investment into real climate impact. What if you’re a partial fit? 🌱 We prioritise grit, positivity, and the willingness to get stuck in, and encourage you to apply even if your experience doesn't exactly match this job description. Equal employment opportunity 🌈 Sylvera is an equal opportunity employer: we value diversity. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, colour, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. AI note-takers 🤖 We sometimes use AI note-takers to help us transcribe interview notes, so we can be more present in your interview. If you'd like to opt out of us using automatic transcribers, please note this in the free text field in your application, otherwise we'll take your application as confirmation that you're happy for us to use notetakers (whether added to video calls or in the background). description: <p>At Qualtrics, we create software that the world’s best brands use to deliver exceptional frontline experiences, build high-performing teams, and design products people love. But we are more than a platform. We are the creators and stewards of the Experience Management category serving over 18,000 clients globally. Building a category takes grit, determination, and an appreciation for the unconventional—but most of all it requires close-knit, high-functioning teams with an unwavering dedication to serving our customers.<br><br>When you join one of our teams, you’ll be part of a nimble group that’s empowered to set ambitious goals and move fast to achieve them. Strategic risks are encouraged, and complex problems are solved by collaborating and iterating until the best solution comes to light. You won’t have to look to find growth opportunities— they’ll find you. From retail to government to healthcare, we’re on a mission to bring humanity, connection, and empathy back to business. Join over 5,000 people across the globe who think that’s work worth doing.</p> <h2 style="text-align: center;">Principal Account Executive — ANZ Public Sector</h2> <p><strong>Why We Have This Role </strong></p> <p>We’re hiring a Principal Account Executive to lead growth across public sector and public utilities clients in ANZ from our Sydney hub. You’ll own complex, high-value opportunities that transform customer and employee experience through our SaaS XM platform, working directly with senior decision-makers (HR, marketing, executive leaders) and partnering with solutions consultants, services, marketing and customer success to design and close strategic programs.</p> <p><strong>How You’ll Find Success</strong></p> <ul> <li>Takes initiative and works entrepreneurially to navigate long, multi-stakeholder sales cycles and complex procurement processes.</li> <li>Builds trusted senior relationships—influencing executives in HR, marketing and broader leadership.</li> <li>Consistent quota achiever with a proven ability to develop pipeline, forecast accurately and close large deals.</li> <li>Skilled at selling SaaS/business transformation software into public or commercial clients.</li> <li>Persuasive, tailored communicator: aligns value messaging to client goals and procurement requirements.</li> <li>Collaborative cross-functional partner who leverages product, services and marketing to create winning solutions.</li> <li>Adaptable to changing policy, market and client priorities in the public sector.</li> </ul> <p><strong>How You’ll Grow</strong></p> <ul> <li>Develop as a strategic partner to government and utility leaders, influencing long-term transformation programs.</li> <li>Deepen expertise in enterprise SaaS for experience management and business transformation across public sector use cases.</li> <li>Expand skills in negotiating large, complex deals and managing procurement &amp; tender processes.</li> <li>Gain visibility and influence across ANZ sales strategy and the broader product roadmap through customer insights.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Things you'll do</strong></p> <ul> <li>Drive revenue and pipeline growth across ANZ public sector and utilities: prospect, qualify and close target accounts to meet and exceed revenue targets.</li> <li>Build strategic account plans, power maps and tailored opportunity strategies, then execute demand-generation and stakeholder engagement to convert opportunities.</li> <li>Engage and nurture stakeholders from champions to C-level, align on value and procurement timelines, and lock in long-term program outcomes.</li> <li>Navigate public procurement and deal execution. Lead tender/RFP responses where applicable and partner with legal, finance and sales ops to remove blockers and ensure compliant contracting.</li> <li>Lead tailored product demonstrations and craft commercial proposals with solutions consultants to maximise customer ROI and win probability.</li> <li>Coordinate a smooth transition to customer success and services teams, track adoption and outcomes, and drive renewal and expansion opportunities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What We’re Looking For On Your Resume</strong></p> <ul> <li>7+ years of SaaS or software sales with a strong track record of meeting/exceeding quota—experience selling enterprise or transformation solutions.</li> <li>Demonstrated success selling into public sector, utilities or similarly complex, procurement-driven markets is highly desirable.</li> <li>Experience engaging senior decision-makers in HR, marketing, executive or program leadership functions.</li> <li>Proven ability to manage long, complex sales cycles, produce reliable forecasts and build a qualified pipeline.</li> <li>Strong negotiation, presentation and consultative discovery skills.</li> <li>Comfortable using Salesforce.com (or similar CRMs) and working with cross-functional sales enablement resources.</li> <li>Relevant tertiary qualifications and familiarity with government procurement/tender processes are advantageous.</li> </ul> <p><strong>What You Should Know About This Team</strong></p> <ul> <li>We’re a high-performing ANZ public sector sales team focused on driving transformation through experience management technology.</li> <li>The role is consultative and strategic—ideal for sellers who enjoy complex deals, long-term programs and executive engagement.</li> <li>Collaboration is central: you’ll work closely with solutions consulting, services, marketing, legal and customer success.</li> <li>The team invests in development and promotes on performance—expect coaching, stretch targets and visible career progression.</li> <li>Working here gives exposure to meaningful public-sector outcomes that impact large populations and communities.</li> </ul> <p><strong>Our Team’s Favourite Perks and Benefits</strong></p> <ul> <li>Salary + uncapped commissions and accelerators.</li> <li>Performance-based promotions—advancement driven by results.</li> <li>Private health insurance with comprehensive medical and extras coverage.</li> <li>Experience Leave — 5 additional days per year for experiences.</li> <li>Hybrid working (typically 3 days in office / 2 from home) and commuter allowance.</li> <li>Catered lunches and a well-stocked kitchen at our North Sydney office.</li> </ul> <div><strong>The Qualtrics Hybrid Work Model</strong>: Our hybrid work model is elegantly simple: we all gather in the office three days a week; Mondays and Thursdays, plus one day selected by your organisational leader. These purposeful in-person days in thoughtfully designed offices help us do our best work and harness the power of collaboration and innovation. For the rest of the week, work where you want, owning the integration of work and life. #hybrid</div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><em>Qualtrics is an equal opportunity employer meaning that all qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, status as a protected veteran, or any other protected characteristic.</em></div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><em>​​​​​​​Applicants in the United States of America have rights under Federal Employment Laws:<a href="https://www.dol.gov/agencies/whd/posters/fmla">Family &amp; Medical Leave Act</a>, <a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/poster">Equal Opportunity Employment</a>, <a href="https://www.dol.gov/agencies/whd/posters/employee-polygraph-protection-act">Employee Polygraph Protection Act</a></em></div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><em>Qualtrics is committed to the inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Qualtrics will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or to receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please let your Qualtrics contact/recruiter know.</em></div> <div>&nbsp;</div> <div><em>Not finding a role that’s the right fit for now? Qualtrics Insiders is the one-stop shop for all things Qualtrics Life. Sign up for exclusive access to content created with you in mind and get the scoop on what we have going on at Qualtrics - upcoming events, behind the scenes stories from the team, interview tips, hot jobs, and more. No spam - we promise! You'll hear from us two times a month max with fresh, totally tailored info - so be sure to stay connected as you explore your best role and company fit.</em></div> Find more English Speaking Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

title: Senior Manager, Product Design (f/m/d)
description: <h2>About The Opportunity</h2> <p>We're looking for a Senior Manager, Product Design to lead a team of product designers working across some of Contentful’s most foundational product areas: content performance optimization, application platform capabilities, business foundations, and design systems. Contentful is the composable content platform powering how the world's leading brands create, manage, and deliver digital experiences. These teams enable our platform's evolution as we build AI native features — turning ambitious product strategy into intuitive, well-crafted experiences for the customers and partners who build on Contentful every day. You'll balance strategic design leadership with people management: coaching designers, raising the bar on craft, and ensuring design has a strong voice in how these foundational parts of the platform take shape.</p> <h2>&nbsp;What To Expect?</h2> <ul> <li>You'll manage designers across three product areas: content performance optimization, application platform capabilities, business infrastructure, and design systems. Optimization, Application Foundations and Business Foundations. While all teams strive to deliver solutions for a holistic, unified platform, each has a distinct focus.&nbsp;</li> <ul> <li>Our Optimization group focuses on advancing personalization and analytics capabilities.&nbsp;</li> <li>Our Application Foundations group includes design systems &amp; information architecture, as well as workflows &amp; automation tooling, and search &amp; discoverability. Notably, the Contentful platform is built on our open source design system, Forma 36.&nbsp;</li> <li>The Business Foundations group focuses on identity &amp; access, monetization, and platform insights.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <li>You'll manage a team of designers you can genuinely invest in — coaching career growth, shaping how they work, and giving them real ownership over their piece of the platform.</li> <li>You'll partner directly with product and engineering leadership on strategy, not just execution to shape how Optimization, Application Foundations, and Business Foundations evolve.</li> <li>You'll help define what AI-native design leadership looks like at Contentful, at a moment when the company is actively maturing that muscle. The Contentful platform includes AI powered customer facing features, and accordingly, we progressively evolve our design tooling and ways of working to take advantage of emerging technologies.&nbsp;</li> <li>You can be located in or near our London hub. The product designers you manage will be located in EMEA as well, distributed across London, Dublin and our Berlin headquarters. Your manager will be US based and you will collaborate with colleagues globally.&nbsp;</li> <li>Some travel is expected. The organization typically has training and/or workshops located in our Berlin headquarters, approximately quarterly.&nbsp;</li> <li>You will be joining at a pivotal moment: Contentful's recent acquisition by Salesforce puts this team's work in front of a massive new customer base, giving you a rare chance to help shape design at a large scale.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <h2><strong>What You Need To Be Successful</strong></h2> <ul> <li>8+ years of product design experience, including 3+ years directly managing and developing product designers, ideally at a B2B SaaS or platform company.</li> <li>Strong track record of partnering with product and engineering leadership at the strategy level, not just translating requirements. You will influence roadmap decisions, represent design's perspective in cross-functional planning, and drive visioning initiatives.&nbsp;</li> <li>A strong customer-centric orientation. You ground design and product decisions in real customer insights and instill that same instinct across your team.</li> <li>A track record of design leadership that extends beyond your own team. Experience shaping and evolving the product design function’s practices within an organization.&nbsp;</li> <li>Maintain a high bar for design craft, with a portfolio reflecting strong interaction and visual design fundamentals. You set and uphold that same bar across your team by giving specific, actionable feedback that sharpens execution, not just strategy.</li> <li>A track record of leading design for complex, multi-team product areas. You should influence a coherent vision that translates across teams supporting a unified platform.&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience owning or contributing to a design system at scale; familiarity with design systems like Forma 36.</li> <li>Demonstrated success managing distributed, global teams.&nbsp;</li> <li>A genuine interest in AI-native product design, including shipping AI-powered customer-facing features, as well as evolving design tooling and workflows.</li> <li>Strong portfolio evidence of coaching designers' career growth. Experience facilitating promotions, skill development, and performance management.&nbsp;</li> <li>Comfort operating in a technically complex, enterprise/platform context. The interfaces and user flows we design operate within a headless, API first context and a mindset of ‘systems thinking’ is paramount.&nbsp;</li> </ul> <p>More details about our company benefits can be found at the following link:&nbsp;<a class="link__new-tab" href="https://www.salesforcebenefits.com/" target="_blank">https://www.salesforcebenefits.com</a>.</p><div class="content-conclusion"><p><strong>Contentful is now officially part of Salesforce.</strong></p> <h2>Unleash Your Potential</h2> <p>When you join Salesforce, you’ll be limitless in all areas of your life. Our benefits and resources support you to find balance and be your best, and our AI agents accelerate your impact so you can do your best. Together, we’ll bring the power of Agentforce to organizations of all sizes and deliver amazing experiences that customers love. Apply today to not only shape the future — but to redefine what’s possible — for yourself, for AI, and the world.<br><br>More details about company benefits can be found at the following link: <a href="https://www.salesforcebenefits.com" target="_blank">https://www.salesforcebenefits.com</a></p> <p><em>If you need reasonable accommodations at any point during the application or interview process, please let your Recruiter know.</em></p> <h2>Equal Opportunity Statement</h2> <p>Salesforce is an equal opportunity employer and maintains a policy of non-discrimination with all employees and applicants for employment. What does that mean exactly? It means that at Salesforce, we believe in equality for all. And we believe we can lead the path to equality in part by creating a workplace that’s inclusive, and free from discrimination.</p> <p><a href="https://www.eeoc.gov/know-your-rights-workplace-discrimination-illegal" target="_blank">Know your rights: workplace discrimination is illegal.</a> Any employee or potential employee will be assessed on the basis of merit, competence and qualifications – without regard to race, religion, color, national origin, sex, sexual orientation, gender expression or identity, transgender status, age, disability, veteran or marital status, political viewpoint, or other classifications protected by law. This policy applies to current and prospective employees, no matter where they are in their Salesforce employment journey. It also applies to recruiting, hiring, job assignment, compensation, promotion, benefits, training, assessment of job performance, discipline, termination, and everything in between. Recruiting, hiring, and promotion decisions at Salesforce are fair and based on merit. The same goes for compensation, benefits, promotions, transfers, reduction in workforce, recall, training, and education.</p> <p><span style="color: #3e3e3e;"><em>Please be aware of scammers who may fraudulently claim to be from Contentful. These types of fraud can occur through copycat websites, fake email addresses claiming to be from our company, or social media. We do not ask for your personal information, such as bank account numbers, identification numbers, etc., through social media or chat-based apps, nor do we request or send money to purchase business equipment. If you suspect fraud, please report it to your local authorities and contact us at <a ----- ----- </em></span><span style="color: #3e3e3e;"><em>with any information you may have.</em></span></p> <p><span style="font-weight: 400;">By clicking “Apply for this job,” I acknowledge that I have read the “</span><a href="https://www.contentful.com/legal/privacy-and-data-protection/privacy-notice-to-candidates/" target="_blank"><span style="font-weight: 400;">Contentful’s Candidate Privacy Notice</span></a><span style="font-weight: 400;">” and hereby consent to the collection, processing, use, and storage of my personal information as described therein.</span></p></div> Find Jobs in United Kingdom on Arbeitnow

description: <div class="content-intro"><h3><strong>A</strong><strong>BOUT TIDE</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we help SMEs save time and money in the running of their businesses by not only offering business accounts and related banking services, but also a comprehensive set of highly usable and connected administrative solutions, from invoicing to accounting.</p> <p>Tide is transforming the small business banking market and now supports over 2 million members globally across the UK, Germany and France.</p> <p>Using advanced technology, all solutions are designed with SMEs in mind. You will report directly to the Chief Data and Technology Officer. Ongoing Monitoring protects our members by detecting fraud, financial crime and regulatory risk across every transaction Tide processes. The engineering, data science and platform capability behind it is one of the most technically demanding estates at Tide.</p> <p>You will be accountable for the engineering strategy, organisation and execution across all Ongoing Monitoring value streams: real-time transaction monitoring for bank payments fraud, acquiring fraud, Anti Money Laundering, Counter Terrorist Financing, sanctions and prohibited activities monitoring, and the tooling our financial investigators depend on. That means ML models in production, agentic AI inside regulated workflows, and multi-market screening infrastructure that stands up to regulatory scrutiny.</p> <p>This role sits at the intersection of regulated risk operations, near real-time platform engineering and applied AI. Our first line operations teams are the primary internal customer, our second line sets the risk appetite, and our regulators set the bar. We need someone who can raise detection quality and reduce fraud losses while driving the cost of monitoring per member down, and scale agentic solutions where a wrong answer has consequences for a member and for Tide.</p> <p>As VP Engineering, Ongoing Monitoring you will:</p> <ul> <li>Set the engineering strategy for Tide's fraud, financial crime and ongoing monitoring platforms</li> <li>Lead engineering across backend, frontend, data science, ML engineering and analytics engineering, primarily based in Hyderabad with product leadership split between Hyderabad and London</li> <li>Lead managers and senior engineers, and build the leadership bench underneath you</li> <li>Work with multiple stakeholders across risk, operations, business, design, product and engineering</li> <li>Own the Decision Engine and Decision Intelligence Platform as shared capabilities, unifying domestic and international payment flows</li> <li>Own the model lifecycle end to end, from development through backtesting, shadow deployment and staged rollout to production performance monitoring</li> <li>Scale agentic AI in regulated workflows, including migrating Ongoing Monitoring agents onto Tide's shared agentic infrastructure and holding the line on our agentic governance framework</li> <li>Deliver measurable risk and efficiency outcomes: lower fraud losses, higher automated alert throughput, and a falling ongoing monitoring cost per member</li> <li>Build the operating model that connects first line operations, second line risk and compliance, payments and acquiring engineering, KYX, AI Platforms and data science leadership behind one roadmap</li> <li>Apply principles so we build once, deploy globally, and keep market-specific logic isolated</li> </ul> <p>This is one of the most important engineering roles at Tide. You will shape how quickly we protect our members, how confidently we enter new markets under our own licences, and how far applied AI can compound into a lasting advantage in a regulated environment.</p> <h3>WHAT WE ARE LOOKING FOR</h3> <ul> <li>Experience leading engineering organisations in fraud, financial crime, risk or another real-time decisioning domain</li> <li>Strong track record of turning platform investment into measurable outcomes across fraud detection and mitigation, unit economics reduction and workflows automation</li> <li>Experience taking machine learning from development into production at scale, and owning model performance once live and fast iteration of model development&nbsp;</li> <li>Experience operating in a regulated environment, working with second line risk and compliance functions and with regulators</li> <li>Strong judgement across organisation design, delivery, platform strategy, data architecture and technical quality</li> <li>Ability to lead distributed teams across multiple markets and align several functions behind one roadmap, operating model and set of priorities</li> <li>Experience deploying AI or agentic systems inside regulated workflows, with a clear view on governance, evaluation and human oversight would be a bonus</li> </ul> <h3>WHAT YOU’LL GET IN RETURN</h3> <p>Our location-specific employee benefits are designed to cater to the unique needs of Tideans:&nbsp;</p> <ul> <li>Competitive Compensation –&nbsp; Competitive salary and share options.</li> <li>Time Off – Generous annual leave on top of bank holidays.</li> <li>Parental Leave – Paid maternity, paternity, and adoption leave to support your family journey.</li> <li>Sabbatical – Extended unpaid and paid leave options after completing milestone years with Tide.</li> <li>Access to salary sacrifice benefits – like Nursery (could save up to 47% on fees!) and Cycle to Work discounts</li> <li>Health Insurance – Comprehensive Private family insurance plan.</li> <li>Life &amp; Accident Cover – Comprehensive accidental and life insurance protection.</li> <li>Mental Wellbeing – Access to therapy sessions, courses, meditations, and workshops.</li> <li>Retirement Planning – Build your retirement fund faster with Tide’s pension scheme on eligible earnings.</li> <li>Volunteering &amp; Development Days – Paid days annually for volunteering or personal growth.</li> <li>Learning &amp; Development – Annual budget for books, courses, coaching, and more.</li> <li>WOO (Work Outside the Office) – Work from abroad for up to 90 days annually.</li> <li>Home Office Setup – Contribution towards setting up your home office.</li> <li>Laptop Ownership – Keep your old laptop and get a new one when it’s time for a replacement.</li> <li>Snacks &amp; Meals – Daily breakfast spread with all-day coffee, tea, and juices.</li> </ul> <h3><strong>TIDEAN WAYS OF WORKING</strong></h3> <p>At Tide, we champion a <strong>flexible workplace </strong>model that<strong> </strong>supports both in-person and remote work to cater to the specific needs of our different teams.&nbsp;</p> <p>While remote work is supported, we believe in the power of face-to-face interactions to foster team spirit and collaboration. title: Montu Pharmacy Assessment Centre
description: Ready to start or take the next step in your pharmacy career? At Montu, we are doing things differently, and that includes how we recruit. We are growing, and we are looking for enthusiastic, hardworking and patient-focused individuals to join our pharmacy team in Winnersh Triangle. Whether you are looking to take your first step into healthcare, explore a new career in pharmacy or bring your existing pharmacy experience to a rapidly growing organisation, we would love to meet you. We are hosting a Pharmacy Assessment Centre on Wednesday 18th November , giving you the opportunity to experience a different approach to recruitment, demonstrate your skills and learn more about what it is like to work at Montu. You do not need previous pharmacy experience for all of our opportunities. For our entry-level positions, what matters most is your attitude, willingness to learn and genuine commitment to making a difference to patients. Our pharmacy is busy. Really busy. It is a lively, energetic environment where things move quickly, teamwork is essential and no two days are quite the same. If you enjoy being on your feet, working alongside others and being part of a team where everyone has a role to play, you could feel right at home. Behind every prescription we process is a patient relying on us to get things right. Whether you are packing medication, dispensing prescriptions or completing final accuracy checks, your contribution matters. Opportunities Available We are recruiting across several positions within our pharmacy team, with opportunities for both experienced pharmacy professionals and individuals looking to enter the industry. Pharmacy Assistant An excellent entry point into the pharmacy sector, with no previous pharmacy experience required. You will support the day-to-day operations of our busy pharmacy, including preparing orders, packing medication, supporting stock management and helping ensure prescriptions are processed accurately and efficiently. We are looking for individuals who are organised, reliable, comfortable with repetitive tasks and enjoy working in a hands-on, fast-paced environment. Trainee Pharmacy Dispenser Looking to develop a career in pharmacy? This could be your opportunity. No previous dispensing experience is required. You will receive training and support as you develop the knowledge and practical skills needed to work within our dispensing team. You will learn about prescription processing, medication handling, accuracy, pharmacy procedures and the importance of maintaining high standards of patient safety. Pharmacy Dispenser For individuals with an existing dispensing qualification and experience working within a pharmacy environment. You will support the safe and accurate dispensing of prescriptions, working closely with pharmacists, technicians and the wider pharmacy team. You will need excellent attention to detail, a strong understanding of pharmacy procedures and the ability to maintain accuracy while managing high prescription volumes. Accuracy Checking Dispenser We are looking for qualified and experienced Accuracy Checking Dispensers who can help maintain the high standards of accuracy and patient safety expected within our pharmacy. You will undertake accuracy checking duties within the scope of your qualification, training and authorisation, supporting the efficient processing of prescriptions and working collaboratively with the wider team. Accuracy Checking Technician (ACT) For qualified Pharmacy Technicians with an accredited accuracy checking qualification and current GPhC registration. You will play an important role in maintaining dispensing accuracy, supporting pharmacy operations and ensuring our processes meet the required professional and regulatory standards. You will bring confidence, attention to detail and the ability to work effectively in a high-volume dispensing environment. What Is Our Pharmacy Assessment Centre? We know that traditional interviews do not always give people the best opportunity to demonstrate what they can do. That is why we are taking a slightly different approach. Our Pharmacy Assessment Centre is designed to be an engaging, practical and interactive experience where you can demonstrate your abilities, meet members of the Montu team and gain a better understanding of our working environment. You can expect a combination of practical and team-based activities designed to assess skills relevant to working within our pharmacy, including: Attention to detail and accuracy Literacy and the ability to follow written instructions Working effectively with others Organisation and the ability to follow processes Speed and efficiency without compromising accuracy Communication and problem-solving We are not expecting everyone to arrive with pharmacy knowledge, particularly those applying for our entry-level opportunities. We are interested in how you approach tasks, how you work with others and whether you have the right attitude to succeed in our environment. What happens after the assessment centre? Candidates who successfully complete the assessment centre will be invited to attend a further on-site interview at Montu on a later date. Please note that attendance at the assessment centre does not guarantee an interview or offer of employment. What Are We Looking For? We are looking for people who genuinely want to be part of a team making a difference. Our ideal candidates will be: Patient-focused: You understand that the work you do has a direct impact on the people relying on our service. Detail-oriented: Accuracy matters, particularly when working with medication. Comfortable in a busy environment: You enjoy an energetic workplace and can remain focused when things get hectic. Reliable and hardworking: You take pride in doing your job well and supporting the people around you. Team players: You understand that pharmacy operations depend on people working together. Adaptable: You are comfortable learning new processes and responding to change. Eager to learn: Whether you are new to pharmacy or already experienced, you are motivated to develop your skills. You do not need to be the loudest person in the room or have years of experience to succeed here. What matters is your work ethic, your attention to detail and your commitment to doing things properly. About Montu Montu is a leading medical cannabis company working to improve access to cannabis-based medicines for patients across the UK. Ready to start or take the next step in your pharmacy career?

At Montu, we are doing things differently, and that includes how we recruit.

We are growing, and we are looking for enthusiastic, hardworking and patient-focused individuals to join our pharmacy team in Winnersh Triangle.

Whether you are looking to take your first step into healthcare, explore a new career in pharmacy or bring your existing pharmacy experience to a rapidly growing organisation, we would love to meet you.

We are hosting a Pharmacy Assessment Centre on Wednesday 18th November, giving you the opportunity to experience a different approach to recruitment, demonstrate your skills and learn more about what it is like to work at Montu.

You do not need previous pharmacy experience for all of our opportunities. For our entry-level positions, what matters most is your attitude, willingness to learn and genuine commitment to making a difference to patients.

Our pharmacy is busy. Really busy. It is a lively, energetic environment where things move quickly, teamwork is essential and no two days are quite the same. If you enjoy being on your feet, working alongside others and being part of a team where everyone has a role to play, you could feel right at home.

Behind every prescription we process is a patient relying on us to get things right. Whether you are packing medication, dispensing prescriptions or completing final accuracy checks, your contribution matters.

Opportunities Available

We are recruiting across several positions within our pharmacy team, with opportunities for both experienced pharmacy professionals and individuals looking to enter the industry.

Pharmacy Assistant

An excellent entry point into the pharmacy sector, with no previous pharmacy experience required.

You will support the day-to-day operations of our busy pharmacy, including preparing orders, packing medication, supporting stock management and helping ensure prescriptions are processed accurately and efficiently.

We are looking for individuals who are organised, reliable, comfortable with repetitive tasks and enjoy working in a hands-on, fast-paced environment.

Trainee Pharmacy Dispenser

Looking to develop a career in pharmacy? This could be your opportunity.

No previous dispensing experience is required. You will receive training and support as you develop the knowledge and practical skills needed to work within our dispensing team.

You will learn about prescription processing, medication handling, accuracy, pharmacy procedures and the importance of maintaining high standards of patient safety.

Pharmacy Dispenser

For individuals with an existing dispensing qualification and experience working within a pharmacy environment.

You will support the safe and accurate dispensing of prescriptions, working closely with pharmacists, technicians and the wider pharmacy team.

You will need excellent attention to detail, a strong understanding of pharmacy procedures and the ability to maintain accuracy while managing high prescription volumes.

Accuracy Checking Dispenser

We are looking for qualified and experienced Accuracy Checking Dispensers who can help maintain the high standards of accuracy and patient safety expected within our pharmacy.

You will undertake accuracy checking duties within the scope of your qualification, training and authorisation, supporting the efficient processing of prescriptions and working collaboratively with the wider team.

Accuracy Checking Technician (ACT)

For qualified Pharmacy Technicians with an accredited accuracy checking qualification and current GPhC registration.

You will play an important role in maintaining dispensing accuracy, supporting pharmacy operations and ensuring our processes meet the required professional and regulatory standards.

You will bring confidence, attention to detail and the ability to work effectively in a high-volume dispensing environment.

What Is Our Pharmacy Assessment Centre?

We know that traditional interviews do not always give people the best opportunity to demonstrate what they can do.

That is why we are taking a slightly different approach.

Our Pharmacy Assessment Centre is designed to be an engaging, practical and interactive experience where you can demonstrate your abilities, meet members of the Montu team and gain a better understanding of our working environment.

You can expect a combination of practical and team-based activities designed to assess skills relevant to working within our pharmacy, including:

  • Attention to detail and accuracy

  • Literacy and the ability to follow written instructions

  • Working effectively with others

  • Organisation and the ability to follow processes

  • Speed and efficiency without compromising accuracy

  • Communication and problem-solving

We are not expecting everyone to arrive with pharmacy knowledge, particularly those applying for our entry-level opportunities.

We are interested in how you approach tasks, how you work with others and whether you have the right attitude to succeed in our environment.

What happens after the assessment centre?

Candidates who successfully complete the assessment centre will be invited to attend a further on-site interview at Montu on a later date.

Please note that attendance at the assessment centre does not guarantee an interview or offer of employment.

What Are We Looking For?

We are looking for people who genuinely want to be part of a team making a difference.

Our ideal candidates will be:

  • Patient-focused: You understand that the work you do has a direct impact on the people relying on our service.

  • Detail-oriented: Accuracy matters, particularly when working with medication.

  • Comfortable in a busy environment: You enjoy an energetic workplace and can remain focused when things get hectic.

  • Reliable and hardworking: You take pride in doing your job well and supporting the people around you.

  • Team players: You understand that pharmacy operations depend on people working together.

  • Adaptable: You are comfortable learning new processes and responding to change.

  • Eager to learn: Whether you are new to pharmacy or already experienced, you are motivated to develop your skills.

You do not need to be the loudest person in the room or have years of experience to succeed here.

What matters is your work ethic, your attention to detail and your commitment to doing things properly.

Your variable pay is uncapped, so there's no ceiling on what you can earn.</p> <h3 id="what-youll-do-1"><strong>What you'll do</strong></h3> <p>Identify and reach high-potential businesses, such as hospitality groups, beauty chains and major retailers</p> <p>Run high-volume outreach by phone, in the field and through other channels</p> <p>Get in front of decision-makers and understand how their business and sites operate</p> <p>Book meetings and run tailored pitches and demos that show how SumUp can support their business</p> <p>Own the full sales cycle, from first contact through to closing the deal</p> <p>Grow your portfolio and network over time, using each win to open the next door</p> <p>Track your performance against targets and use feedback and data to keep improving</p> <h3 id="what-were-looking-for-1"><strong>What we're looking for…</strong></h3> <ul> <li>Proven experience in outbound sales, with a track record of hitting targets</li> <li>Comfort with high volumes of outreach, by phone or in the field</li> <li>Real drive and resilience: you stay motivated when deals take time or doors stay closed</li> <li>Confidence and the ability to build strong relationships with business owners and decision-makers</li> <li>Comfort with having freedom in how you work, alongside hands-on coaching and support from your team lead</li> <li>Fluency in French and English</li> </ul> <h3 id="why-you-should-join-sumup-1"><strong>Why you should join SumUp</strong></h3> <p>💰 Uncapped variable pay: strong performance can significantly increase your earnings</p> <p>🌎 Opportunity to work with a truly global, multicultural team from our Paris location.
